Motivation: 现有推理诊断方法普遍依赖"阶段回放"假设，即重建中间token前缀后以fresh-prefill续写能忠实代表原始解码器状态下的续写结果。该假设缺乏严格的实验验证，尤其是在整个推理阶段边界处。作者希望通过受控实验审计这一假设是否成立，以及数值精度（BF16 vs FP32）如何影响该假设的有效性。

Method: 采用200项匹配对照实验：一侧保留实时缓存（retained live cache），另一侧对完全相同的整数token做一次性预填充（one-shot prefill），两侧构造精确副本。设计固定前缀2x2实验，保持200个token状态不变而交叉两个因素：构造方式（实时缓存 vs 预填充）与数值精度（BF16 vs FP32）。再做12/12行的逐token增量桥接，以及48个Key/Value层的双向移植实验（24/24主检查点 + 43/43无结果偏倚的后期检查点复制），并用all-200保存账本审计复现轨迹。

Result: BF16下副本虽精确但166个后缀和20个正确性标签出现构造差异，准确率仅差1点（配对95%CI [-3.5, +5.5]）。FP32下无解码分歧（95% Wilson上界1.88%）。增量桥接使token逐位的实时与保留缓存达到12/12位精确一致；双向移植中，所有检测到的发散续写均跟随其缓存供体（24/24和43/43）。

Conclusion: 精确token回放在数值上是可重复的，但并不能保证对实时解码状态的忠实性。在所测状态下，边界KV缓存是发散轨迹的因果充分载体，数值精度（BF16的不确定性 vs FP32的确定性）调节了这种因果性在行为上的表达。这为推理诊断方法提供了重要的方法论边界：回放的可复现性不等于状态保真性。

Abstract: Stage-replay diagnostics reconstruct intermediate token prefixes and treat fresh-prefill continuation as continuation from the decoder state that originally reached the prefix. We audit that assumption at a whole reasoning-stage boundary in a Qwen2.5-derived system. A matched 200-item experiment compares retained live cache with one-shot prefill of identical integer tokens and places an exact replica on both sides. In BF16, replicas remain exact while the constructions differ on 166 suffixes and 20 correctness labels; the accuracy difference is only one point (paired 95% CI [-3.5, +5.5]). A fixed-prefix 2x2 holds all 200 token states constant while crossing construction and precision. The BF16 disagreements recur, whereas FP32 produces no decoded disagreement (95% Wilson upper bound 1.88%). A prospective bridge makes token-by-token incremental and retained live caches bit-exact on 12/12 rows; an all-200 saved-ledger audit reproduces every retained trajectory and comparison fingerprint. Bidirectional transplantation of all 48 key/value layers makes every tested divergent continuation follow its cache donor, both on a selected set at the primary checkpoint (24/24) and an outcome-blind replication at a later checkpoint (43/43). Exact-token replay can therefore be repeatable without preserving live-state fidelity. On the tested states, boundary K/V cache is a causally sufficient carrier of the divergent trajectory, while numerical precision moderates its behavioral expression.

</details>


### [273] [Chem World: A Large-Scale Benchmark and Physics-Informed Framework for Trustworthy Chemical Property Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28079)
*Tianyou Bai,Huan Wang,Mingchen Gao,Fangyue Lin,Pinze Ren,Zhenlin Zhao,Siming Dong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了Chem World基准测试平台，整合17个化学数据集和超过80万个分子样本，用于化学性质预测评估；同时提出Mixture-PINN框架，将物理先验知识融入数据驱动的神经网络，提升化学性质预测的准确性、鲁棒性和可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的化学性质预测基准存在任务多样性有限、数据集碎片化、评估协议不一致等问题，导致难以系统评估AI模型的可靠性和泛化能力。作者旨在建立一个统一、大规模、标准化的基准平台来弥补这些不足。

Method: 1) 构建Chem World基准：整合17个化学数据集，覆盖超过80万个分子样本，包含密度、电导率、溶解度等多种分子性质预测任务，提供统一评估平台。2) 提出Mixture-PINN框架：一种物理信息神经网络方法，将化学先验知识嵌入数据驱动学习过程，以提升预测性能。

Result: 在Chem World基准上进行了大量实验，结果表明所提出的Mixture-PINN方法相比现有方法在化学性质预测方面具有更优的有效性。

Conclusion: Chem World结合大规模标准化评估与物理信息学习，为计算化学领域可信AI系统的开发奠定了坚实基础，推动了AI驱动的科学发现。

Abstract: Chemical property prediction plays a critical role in accelerating scientific discovery in chemistry, materials science, and drug development. However, existing benchmarks often suffer from limited task diversity, fragmented datasets, and inconsistent evaluation protocols, making it challenging to systematically assess the reliability and generalization of AI models. In this work, we introduce Chem World, a comprehensive benchmark for chemical property prediction that integrates 17 diverse chemical datasets with over 800,000 molecular samples, covering various properties including density, electrical conductivity, solubility, and other molecular characteristics. Chem World provides a unified platform for evaluating AI models across multiple property prediction tasks. Furthermore, we propose Mixture-PINN, a physics-informed neural network based prediction framework that incorporates chemical prior knowledge into data-driven learning, improving the accuracy, robustness, and reliability of chemical property prediction. Extensive experiments on Chem World demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach compared with existing methods. By combining large-scale standardized evaluation with physics-informed learning, Chem World establishes a foundation for developing trustworthy AI systems for computational chemistry and advancing AI-driven scientific discovery.

</details>


### [274] [From Expert Reduction to Behavioral Divergence: Tracing Numerical State through Sparse MoE Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28097)
*Tianyang Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究在原生DeepSeek-V4-Flash中冻结局部MoE状态、仅改变聚合语义，证明数学上等价的专家缩减顺序会产生可观测不同的稀疏MoE执行结果，并精确定位了tokens内与跨token的连续性边界，提出构建稀疏MoE运行时的数值兼容性契约。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏MoE模型中，理论上数学等价的专家归约顺序在实际执行中可能产生可观测差异，但此前缺乏在原生模型上系统隔离并量化该效应的工作。理解这一现象对于运行时的一致性、可复现性和硬件后端相容性至关重要。

Method: 冻结DeepSeek-V4-Flash中的局部MoE状态，仅改变聚合语义，设计四种方案分离操作数表示与累加器精度；系统枚举A/B两种模式的缩减阶数（720种），结合中文提示分类不同连续性行为；并通过192条持久轨迹追踪、穷举P32/A/B/C四种方案的路线与状态对比，对受控B分支进行精确后mHC与FP64全持久状态重建，验证下游状态一致性。

Result: A模式720种顺序产生10个延续盆地，B模式形成360个精确结构类与11个盆地；某中文提示下B类分裂为202种裁员、113种雇佣、45种其他延续。最大L-infinity B分支选择可按8/16/32 token区分部分提示。P32/A/B改变所有原生参考路线轨迹，C保持路线、token序列与文本不变，且C在192轨迹检查中与原生MoE各状态位级一致。精确FP64重建可复现下游七步301个状态、checkpoint、路线、预测与文本。

Conclusion: 研究将专家操作数转换、累加器精度与归约顺序定义为稀疏MoE运行时和硬件后端的数值兼容性契约组成部分。后mHC是token内边界，全持久状态是跨token延续边界；相同token不必然意味着相同的自回归状态。但结果仅确立受控因果可能性而非部署发生率，且C的阶不变性仅限于已评估的六项状态与调度。

Abstract: Mathematically equivalent expert-reduction orders can produce observably different sparse-MoE executions. We isolate this effect in native DeepSeek-V4-Flash by freezing local MoE state and varying only aggregation semantics. Four schemes separate operand representation from accumulator precision. At one layer-5 fork, 720 A-mode orders yield 10 continuation basins; 720 B-mode orders form 360 exact structural classes and 11 basins. Under one Chinese prompt, the B classes split into 202 layoffs, 113 hiring, and 45 other continuations. Maximum-L-infinity B-branch selection separates 12, 24, and 36 of 50 prompts by 8, 16, and 32 tokens. Across 192 persistent trajectories per scheme, P32, A, and B change every native-reference route trajectory, while C preserves routes, token sequences, and texts. A separate 192-trajectory C check matches native MoE, post-mHC, next-router, and LM states bitwise. For one controlled B branch, exact post-mHC endpoint reconstruction reproduces the measured downstream trajectory. At the next decode boundary, exact FP64 reconstruction of the branch's full persistent state yields agreement for 301 downstream post-mHC states, 301 persistent-state checkpoints, 301 routes, predictions, and text over seven steps, given the same naturally generated next input. These controls identify post-mHC as an intra-token boundary and full persistent state as a cross-token continuation boundary. Identical tokens need not imply identical autoregressive state: divergence can survive a token boundary and become visible later. These results make expert operand conversion, accumulator precision, and reduction order part of a numerical compatibility contract for sparse-MoE runtimes and hardware backends. They establish controlled causal possibility, not deployment incidence; C's order invariance is limited to evaluated six-term states and schedules.

</details>


### [275] [Information Bottleneck Learning for Faithful Time Series Forecasting Explanations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28124)
*Xu Zheng,Wei Cheng,Zhuomin Chen,Mo Sha,Jingchao Ni,Dongsheng Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: IB-Forecast 是一个内在可解释的多变量时间序列预测框架，通过信息瓶颈约束的端到端优化，将预测分解为周期项和基于可解释掩码的残差项，在匹配黑盒模型预测精度的同时提供高忠实度的原生解释，且仅需14-20%的观测数据即可实现低误差预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可解释预测器虽然能揭示内部结构，但不能保证其结构忠实反映驱动预测的底层证据；而面向忠实度的方法几乎只针对事后分类任务。两者之间存在明显空白，缺乏既内在可解释又保证解释忠实度的多元时间序列预测框架。

Method: 将预测分解为可学习的周期分量和基于输入token可解释掩码计算的残差分量；采用带预算约束的信息瓶颈进行端到端优化，允许用户直接控制解释稀疏度；并设计了严格的忠实度评估协议。

Result: IB-Forecast在预测误差上与领先的黑盒模型相当，且在无需额外推理成本的情况下提供忠实解释；在相同稀疏度预算下，其原生解释在所有数据集上一致优于基于梯度、遮挡和优化的基线。

Conclusion: 现有可解释预测器的原生解释忠实度差，而IB-Forecast保证了高解释保真度，仅需14-20%的观测即可实现低误差预测。

Abstract: As forecasts increasingly drive decisions in fields such as energy, transportation, and healthcare, understanding the historical data behind these predictions has become as crucial as the predictions themselves. Although existing interpretable-by-design forecasters reveal their internal structures, they offer no guarantee that these structures faithfully reflect the underlying evidence driving the predictions. In contrast, while faithfulness-oriented methods explicitly verify model behavior, they are almost exclusively designed for post-hoc classification tasks. To bridge this gap, we propose IB-Forecast, an inherently interpretable multivariate time-series forecasting framework. It decomposes forecasting into a learned periodic component and a residual component computed with explainable masks over input tokens. With a budget-constrained information bottleneck, end-to-end optimization enables users to directly control explanation sparsity. With a rigorous faithfulness evaluation protocol, extensive experiments demonstrate that IB-Forecast matches the forecasting error of leading black-box models while providing faithful explanations at no additional inference cost. Furthermore, under a matched sparsity budget, these native explanations consistently surpass gradient-based, occlusion-based, and optimization-based baselines across all evaluated datasets. Ultimately, whereas the native explanations of existing interpretable forecasters exhibit poor faithfulness, IB-Forecast guarantees high explanation fidelity, requiring only 14-20% of the observations to deliver low-error predictions.

</details>


### [276] [LM-GRASP: Instance-Specific Language Models for Combinatorial Construction via Online Imitation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28135)
*Mohand Mezmaz,Grégoire Danoy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LM-GRASP，一种将GRASP随机构造阶段重构为在线模仿学习任务的元启发式框架。它从零开始在单个实例上训练解码器Transformer作为构造策略，无需离线预训练或问题特定特征工程，在Taillard PFSP基准上相比GPU-GRASP平均提升28.4个makespan单位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统机器学习组合优化方法依赖在大规模离线数据集上通过强化学习训练神经构造器，存在预训练成本高且泛化能力差的问题。经典GRASP依赖静态、短视的启发式规则，基于局部标量成本，无法充分挖掘搜索过程中发现的高质量解信息。

Method: 将GRASP的随机构造阶段重构成在线模仿学习任务：局部搜索作为专家oracle提供示范，解码器Transformer作为构造策略。采用learn-infer-improve迭代循环，通过行为克隆在动态精英轨迹档案上在线训练策略，与领域仅通过目标评估器交互，无需任何外部数据或离线预训练。

Result: 在Taillard PFSP基准（ta51-ta60）上，LM-GRASP比GPU-GRASP平均提升28.4个makespan单位，这一增益与GPU加速相对串行执行的提升（27.2单位）相当，尽管标准差有重叠。

Conclusion: 实例特定、在线训练的语言模型是手工构造器的有前景且实用的替代方案，尤其对于经典贪婪构造难以奏效的搜索景观。

Abstract: Machine learning for combinatorial optimization typically relies on neural constructors trained via reinforcement learning on large offline datasets for a fixed problem class-incurring high pretraining costs and generalizing poorly outside the training distribution. We propose an alternative: a metaheuristic framework that reformulates the randomized constructive phase of GRASP as an online imitation learning task, trained from scratch on each problem instance. A local search procedure acts as an expert oracle, while a decoder-only Transformer serves as the constructive policy. Unlike classical GRASP, which relies on static, myopic heuristic rules based on localized scalar costs, our approach is fully data-driven: the construction policy emerges from high-quality solutions discovered during the search itself, with no problem-specific feature engineering required.
  We instantiate this as LM-GRASP, a hybrid metaheuristic following an iterative learn-infer-improve cycle, training the policy online via behavioral cloning on a dynamic archive of elite trajectories-no external data or offline pretraining needed. The pipeline interfaces with the domain solely through the objective evaluator used by local search.
  Evaluated on the Taillard PFSP benchmark (ta51-ta60), the most discriminating block due to half its optima being unknown, LM-GRASP outperforms GPU-GRASP by 28.4 makespan units on average-comparable to the gain from GPU acceleration over sequential execution (27.2 units), though with overlapping standard deviations. This suggests instance-specific, online-trained language models are a promising, practical alternative to hand-engineered constructors, especially for landscapes resistant to classical greedy construction.

</details>


### [277] [Search Strategies for Optimal Classification and Regression Trees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28170)
*Jacobus G. M. van der Linden,Mim van den Bos,Emir Demirović*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个通用的最优决策树（ODT）算法框架，能够实例化已有的搜索策略并定义新策略，通过统一视角对18种搜索策略进行实证比较，找出最佳策略在分类任务的任意时刻性能上显著优于现有方法，在回归任务上运行速度提升一个数量级以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 最优决策树（ODTs）是紧凑且可解释的机器学习模型，能够全局优化给定目标，但可扩展性仍是挑战。尽管已有工作提出了多种搜索策略来改善可扩展性，但每种策略的具体贡献尚不明确，缺乏统一比较的框架。

Method: 提出一个通用的最优决策树算法框架，该框架能够实例化之前使用的各种搜索策略，同时支持定义新的策略；基于此框架对18种不同的搜索策略进行系统的实证研究，以统一视角理解和比较各种策略的效果。

Result: 实验结果表明，与现有最先进方法相比，最佳搜索策略在分类任务上取得了显著更好的任意时刻（anytime）性能，在回归任务上运行时间提升超过一个数量级（即超过10倍）。

Conclusion: 统一的算法框架有助于厘清不同搜索策略对ODT可扩展性的贡献，最佳策略的组合能够在分类和回归任务上分别带来显著的性能与效率提升。

Abstract: Optimal decision trees (ODTs) are compact, interpretable machine learning models that globally optimize a given objective, but their scalability remains challenging. While recent work has proposed a variety of search strategies to improve scalability, the precise contribution of each strategy remains unclear. To address this gap, we introduce a general algorithmic framework for ODTs that instantiates previously used search strategies and enables the definition of new ones. This provides a common lens through which to understand and compare different strategies, which we use to empirically investigate the effect of 18 search strategies. Compared to the state of the art, the best strategy in our evaluation achieves significantly better anytime performance for classification, and improves runtime by more than an order of magnitude for regression.

</details>


### [278] [Multi-channel Uplift Policy Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28182)
*Changjian Liu,Tianyu Wang,Xiaoxuan Deng,WenTao Zhu,Yuwei Xu,Jungqi Jin,Yong Gao,Chuan Yu,Jian Xu,Bo Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ReAlloc，一种面向电商多渠道预算分配的快速-慢速因果框架，解决标准预测-优化范式在组合空间中因观测混杂和严重外推导致的失效问题。它通过正交教师网络提取短期无偏局部梯度，再由解释引导的学生网络将其蒸馏为长期结构化边际场，实现支持感知的保守决策并捕捉跨渠道替代效应。淘宝平台的大规模在线A/B测试验证了其在支付订单和收入上的双重提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电商平台需要在多个渠道间分配固定营销预算以最大化业务效用。然而，标准的预测-后-优化（PTO）范式在组合空间中因观测混杂（observational confounding）和严重外推（severe extrapolation）而失效，亟需一种能够处理这一挑战的新方法。

Method: 将预算分配问题建模为单纯形约束的增量（uplift）决策问题，提出ReAlloc快速-慢速因果框架：敏捷的"正交教师"（Orthogonal Teacher）从短期日志中提取无偏局部梯度，而"解释引导学生"（Explanation-Guided Student）将这些梯度蒸馏为长期时间尺度上的结构化边际场，从而支持感知地做出保守决策，并捕捉跨渠道替代效应。

Result: 在广泛模拟和大规模淘宝平台在线A/B测试中，ReAlloc在支付订单和收入两个指标上均实现了同步提升。

Conclusion: ReAlloc通过快速-慢速因果框架有效解决了多渠道预算分配中的混杂和泛化问题，在实际电商平台中验证了其商业价值。

Abstract: E-commerce platforms must allocate fixed marketing budgets across multiple channels to maximize business utility. However, standard predict-then-optimize (PTO) paradigms fail in this compositional space due to observational confounding and severe extrapolation. We formulate this challenge as a simplex-constrained uplift decision problem and propose ReAlloc, a fast-slow causal framework. Specifically, an agile Orthogonal Teacher extracts unbiased local gradients from short-term logs, while an Explanation-Guided Student distills them into a structured marginal field over long-term horizons. This design enables support-aware, conservative decisions that capture cross-channel substitutions. Extensive simulations and large-scale online A/B tests on Taobao platform demonstrate that ReAlloc achieves simultaneous lifts in both pay order and income.

</details>


### [279] [TopoFormer: Topology Meets Attention for Graph Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28259)
*Md Joshem Uddin,Astrit Tola,Cuneyt Gurcan Akcora,Baris Coskunuzer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Topoformer，一种轻量级且可扩展的图表示学习框架。其核心模块Topo-Scan通过节点或边过滤（filtration）将图分解为简短有序的拓扑token序列，这些序列捕获从局部模体到全局组织的多尺度结构模式，并由Transformer处理以生成图级嵌入。与传统的持续同调（persistent homology）流程不同，Topo-Scan可并行化、避免昂贵的图表计算，并能无缝集成到标准深度学习架构中。论文提供了拓扑编码稳定性的理论保证，并在图分类和分子性质预测基准上展示了最先进的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的持续同调方法虽然能为图表示学习提供拓扑归纳偏置，但通常计算成本高昂、难以并行化，并且与深度学习架构的集成不够顺畅。现有GNN方法虽然强大，但往往缺乏对图全局拓扑结构的显式建模。作者希望通过一种可并行化、轻量级的方式，将拓扑信息编码为适合注意力机制处理的序列形式，从而弥合拓扑学与深度学习之间的鸿沟。

Method: Topoformer的核心创新是Topo-Scan模块，它通过沿节点或边过滤（filtration）对图进行切片，将图分解为一条简短有序的拓扑token序列。这些序列捕捉了不同尺度下的结构模式，从局部模体到全局组织。随后，Transformer架构对这些拓扑token序列进行处理，生成具有表达力的图级嵌入。与标准的持续同调管道相比，Topo-Scan避免了图表（persistence diagram）的计算，具备并行化优势，并设计为可直接嵌入标准深度学习架构中。

Result: 在多个图分类和分子性质预测基准上，Topoformer达到了最先进的性能。实验表明，Topoformer在匹配或超越强GNN基线和基于拓扑的方法的同时，提供了可预测且高效的计算开销。论文还给出了拓扑编码稳定性的理论保证。

Conclusion: Topoformer为图表示学习开辟了一条新的路径，展示了将拓扑归纳偏置集成到注意力框架中的可行性和有效性。该工作提出了一种并行化、统一的方法，有望推动拓扑感知的深度学习在图相关任务中的进一步发展。

Abstract: We introduce Topoformer, a lightweight and scalable framework for graph representation learning that encodes topological structure into attention-friendly sequences. At the core of our method is Topo-Scan, a novel module that decomposes a graph into a short, ordered sequence of topological tokens by slicing over node or edge filtrations. These sequences capture multi-scale structural patterns, from local motifs to global organization, and are processed by a Transformer to produce expressive graph-level embeddings. Unlike traditional persistent homology pipelines, Topo-Scan is parallelizable, avoids costly diagram computations, and integrates seamlessly with standard deep learning architectures. We provide theoretical guarantees on the stability of our topological encodings and demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across graph classification and molecular property prediction benchmarks. Our results show that Topoformer matches or exceeds strong GNN and topology-based baselines while offering predictable and efficient compute. This work opens a new path for parallelizable and unifying approaches to graph representation learning that integrate topological inductive biases into attention frameworks.

</details>


### [280] [HARGO: Heterogeneity-Aware Reward-Guided Optimization for RL Post-Training of LLMs on HPC Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28301)
*Tiangang Li,Xiangbo Tian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HARGO是一种异构感知的奖励引导优化方法，通过置信度调制的逐响应重要性加权（结合组级奖励对比和参考模型log-probability的置信度信号），无需任务类型标签即可适配HPC任务的高异质性，在四项HPC任务和九种方法中取得了最优的全面对齐质量（WinRate 54.62%、Data Race F1 91.30%、PLP Similarity 0.8558）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 监督微调（SFT）虽然能为LLM注入HPC领域知识（如数据竞态检测、基准问答），但"有知识不等于有正确行为"：同一SFT模型在C/C++数据竞态分类上准确率达88.65%，却在事实问答中产生冗长不精确的回答（65.9%的MLPerf响应超过40字符）。RL后训练虽可优化任务特定奖励，但HPC任务存在极端异构性——二分类、事实QA和语义生成在答案长度上相差58倍，跨越三种不同的奖励分布，且SFT准确率差异巨大，这使得GRPO等统一权重的RL方法表现次优。

Method: HARGO（Heterogeneity-Aware Reward-Guided Optimization）引入逐响应重要性加权，通过置信度调制的优势（confidence-modulated advantage）实现：1) 从组级奖励对比中计算判别信号（discrimination signal）；2) 从参考模型log-probabilities中计算置信信号（confidence signal）；3) 将两个信号调制到优势值上，再计算逐响应权重。整个过程无需任务类型标签，自动适应不同任务的奖励分布差异。

Result: 在四项HPC任务和九种对比方法中，HARGO在三个主要指标上均取得最佳性能：WinRate 54.62%、Data Race F1 91.30%、PLP Similarity 0.8558。消融实验确认了判别信号和置信信号两者的贡献是互补的。

Conclusion: HARGO在异构HPC任务中建立了最佳的全面对齐质量，证明了面向异构任务设计自适应奖励优化策略的有效性，超越了统一权重RL方法（如GRPO）。

Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can equip large language models (LLMs) with domain knowledge for high-performance computing (HPC) tasks such as data race detection and benchmark question answering. However, knowledge alone does not guarantee task-appropriate behavior: the same SFT model that correctly classifies 88.65\% of C/C++ data race samples produces verbose, imprecise answers to factual queries, with 65.9\% of MLPerf responses exceeding 40 characters. Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training addresses this gap by optimizing for task-specific rewards rather than token-level imitation. Yet HPC tasks exhibit extreme heterogeneity, with binary classification, factual QA, and semantic generation differing by 58x in answer length, spanning three distinct reward distributions, and showing widely varying SFT accuracy. This makes uniform-weight RL methods such as GRPO suboptimal. We propose HARGO, Heterogeneity-Aware Reward-Guided Optimization, which introduces per-response importance weighting via confidence-modulated advantage: computing a discrimination signal from group-level reward contrast and a confidence signal from reference model log-probabilities, then modulating the advantage before computing per-response weights, without requiring task-type labels. Across four HPC tasks and nine methods, HARGO achieves the best performance on all three primary metrics: WinRate 54.62\%, Data Race F1 91.30\%, and PLP Similarity 0.8558. Ablation confirms complementary contributions from both signals. HARGO establishes the best overall alignment quality among compared methods for heterogeneous HPC tasks.

</details>


### [281] [Semi-Supervised Learning for Molecular Graphs via Ensemble Consensus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28304)
*Rasmus Tirsgaard,Laurits Fredsgaard,Marisa Wodrich,Mikkel Jordahn,Mikkel N. Schmidt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出利用集成共识（ensemble consensus）的半监督学习方法，在分子科学领域无需标签保持增强（label-preserving augmentations）即可提升图神经网络在多种分子数据集上的预测精度，且优于传统监督训练的全集成模型，同时降低校准误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子科学中标注数据获取成本高、耗时长，而大量未标注分子数据容易获得。标准的半监督方法依赖标签保持增强，但在分子领域微小变化可能大幅改变性质，难以设计此类增强。因此需要一种不依赖标签保持增强的替代半监督策略。

Method: 利用集成共识目标（ensemble consensus objective）作为半监督训练损失，不依赖标签保持增强。通过集成成员之间的预测一致性对未标注数据进行正则化，并结合多种图神经网络架构在多样化的分子数据集与任务类型上进行验证。

Result: 集成共识半监督方法在多种分子数据集、任务类型和GNN架构上均提升了预测精度。训练后的单个集成成员在几乎所有情况下优于传统监督方式训练的全集成模型，该效果类似于知识蒸馏；同时该方法降低了模型的校准误差。

Conclusion: 集成共识是一种有效且通用的分子领域半监督学习方法，能提高模型鲁棒性、单模型性能和校准质量，为分子科学中缺乏标注数据的场景提供了可行的解决方案。

Abstract: Machine learning is transforming molecular sciences by accelerating property prediction, simulation, and the discovery of new molecules and materials. Acquiring labeled data in these domains is often costly and time-consuming, whereas large collections of unlabeled molecular data are readily available. Standard semi-supervised learning methods often rely on label-preserving augmentations, which are challenging to design in the molecular domain, where minor changes can drastically alter properties. In this work, we show that semi-supervised methods that rely on an ensemble consensus can boost predictive accuracy across a diverse range of molecular datasets, task types, and graph neural network architectures. We find that training with an ensemble consensus objective increases robustness in models and exhibits an effect similar to knowledge distillation; an individual member of an ensemble trained this way outperforms a full ensemble trained in a traditional supervised fashion in almost all cases. In addition, this type of semi-supervised training reduces calibration error.

</details>


### [282] [Beyond Geometric Complementarity: Coherent Overlap in Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28308)
*Huiyuan Tian,Bonan Xu,Shijian Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过引入Expert Subspace Separation Index（ESSI）、匹配路线残差和前缀控制2×2因子设计，将MoE语言模型中路由一致性、候选质量和候选-上下文交互三种量区分开来。研究发现：专家子空间高度重叠但实际路由仍优于匹配替代方案；所选专家在解释残差表示上始终优于最强未选中对手，但真实前缀缩窄了这一优势（所有交互均为负）；几何缩窄并不等于功能冗余，后续专家仍改善下一token预测。作者将这一联合模式称为"coherent overlap"（相干重叠）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏MoE语言模型将每个token路由到多个专家，其优势被认为源于共同选中的专家应贡献不同的表示方向（几何解释）。但现有证据常混淆三个不同量：路由一致性、候选质量和候选×上下文的交互作用。作者希望厘清这些量，以判断几何相似性是否能决定专家冗余或剪枝价值，从而回答MoE中"几何重叠是否意味着功能冗余"这一核心问题。

Method: 提出了三个工具来分离上述量：(1) Expert Subspace Separation Index (ESSI)用于量化专家子空间重叠；(2) 匹配路线残差（matched-route residuals）区分路由一致性与候选质量；(3) 前缀控制的2×2因子设计分离候选效应与上下文交互。此外使用冻结路线干预（frozen-route interventions）和受控Top-k训练研究评估功能价值。通过三对对比组织分析（跨6种MoE架构、39个因子单元覆盖OLMoE/Mixtral/DeepSeek）。

Result: (1) 六个MoE架构中专家子空间显著重叠，但实际路线对token表示的解释优于匹配替代方案；(2) 在全部39个因子单元中，所选候选对残差表示的解释力均超过最强未选对手，然而真实前缀在所有单元中缩窄了这一优势——所有交互为负，所有95%置信区间低于零；(3) 几何缩窄不意味着功能冗余：39个冻结路线比较中24个显示增加后期专家改善下一token预测，其余15个不具结论性；受控训练研究中Top-2在3个种子中均优于Top-1。

Conclusion: 将路由一致性、候选质量和交互效应分离后，揭示了一个联合模式"相干重叠"（coherent overlap）：路由从共享的几何邻域中选择与token相关的专家，但同时保持有效的多专家计算，无需不相交的线性覆盖。这一发现表明，几何相似性本身不能决定专家冗余或剪枝价值，为MoE架构的评估与压缩提供了更精确的理论基础。

Abstract: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models route each token to multiple experts, suggesting a geometric account of their benefit: co-selected experts should contribute distinct representation directions. Existing evidence often conflates route coherence, candidate quality, and candidate-by-context interaction. We distinguish these quantities using an Expert Subspace Separation Index (ESSI), matched-route residuals, and a prefix-controlled $2\times2$ factorial; frozen-route interventions and a controlled Top-$k$ study assess functional value. Three paired contrasts organize the findings. First, across six MoE architectures, expert subspaces overlap substantially, yet actual routes explain token representations better than matched alternatives. Second, across the 39 factorial cells in OLMoE, Mixtral, and DeepSeek, the selected candidate explains more of the residual representation than the strongest unselected rival in every cell, yet the actual prefix narrows this advantage throughout: all interactions are negative, and every 95% confidence interval lies below zero. Third, this geometric narrowing does not imply functional redundancy: adding later experts improves next-token prediction in 24 of 39 frozen-route comparisons, while the other 15 estimates are inconclusive; a controlled training study also favors Top-2 over Top-1 in all three seeds. We call this joint pattern coherent overlap: routing selects token-relevant experts from a shared geometric neighborhood, while useful multi-expert computation persists without disjoint linear coverage. Separating these quantities clarifies why geometric similarity alone cannot determine redundancy or pruning value.

</details>


### [283] [Measuring Distortion in the Empty Regions of Dimensionality Reduction Scatterplots with the Gap Index](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28324)
*Jaume Ros,Alessio Arleo,Fernando Paulovich*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Gap Index (GI)，一种用于2D降维投影的质量度量指标，通过测量投影中空白区域的空间形变来捕捉视觉失真，不同于只关注点间直接关系（如距离或邻域）的传统度量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主流质量度量指标仅关注点之间的直接关系（如距离或邻域），忽略了投影布局中空白区域（empty areas）的形变，而这些空白区域往往构成2D布局中视觉上重要的特征。

Method: GI通过将投影空间分解为三角形（空三角形，empty triangles），再将每个三角形与其高维空间中的对应三角形进行比较，计算其形变程度。单个三角形的形变可以聚合成一个标量值，也可以叠加在投影上以可视化局部区域的形变模式。

Result: 与流行的质量度量相比，GI对具有高视觉影响的小型结构形变敏感；同时计算速度快且结果可解释。

Conclusion: GI作为一种新颖的质量度量指标，弥补了传统度量对空白区域形变忽视的不足，能够更全面地评估降维投影的视觉质量。

Abstract: Quality metrics play a crucial role in the proper use of dimensionality reduction projections for visual analysis of high-dimensional data. They quantify the degree of distortion of a projection compared to the high-dimensional data and provide a reliable indication of how confident users can be in the structures they see in the resulting layouts. However, most popular metrics focus on capturing direct relationships between points (e.g., distances or neighborhoods) while neglecting distortions in empty areas of the layout, even though these often compose visually relevant features of a 2D layout. In this paper, we introduce the Gap Index (GI), a quality metric for 2D projections that captures visual distortion by measuring spatial distortion in empty areas of a projection. It does so by decomposing the space into empty triangles, which are then compared to their high-dimensional counterparts to compute the deformation. This per-triangle deformation can be aggregated into a single scalar value or overlaid on a projection to visualize regional distortion patterns. Results show that, contrary to popular quality metrics, the GI is sensitive to small structural deformations that have high visual impact. It is also fast to compute and interpretable.

</details>


### [284] [Encryption-Compatible Clustered Federated Learning via Distributed Expectation-Maximization over Metadata](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28338)
*Michael Ben Ali,Imen Megdiche,André Péninou,Olivier Teste*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FLAMECHE提出了一种将基于元数据的聚类联邦学习(CFL)重述为分布式期望最大化(EM)过程的方法，通过将服务器更新限制为加法操作，使得聚类过程与标准联邦学习隐私保护机制兼容，从而在隐私、通信和计算效率三者之间取得更好平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聚类联邦学习(CFL)面临隐私保护、通信成本和计算效率之间的权衡，即CFL三难困境。现有的基于元数据的聚类方法虽然通信和计算高效，但与标准FL隐私保护机制不兼容，这是一个关键局限性。

Method: FLAMECHE将基于元数据的CFL重新表述为分布式期望最大化(EM)过程，其关键设计在于将服务器更新限制为加法操作，从而在不牺牲效率的前提下与实用的安全联邦学习方案兼容。

Result: 在多个数据集和各种异构场景下的大量实验表明，FLAMECHE提高了客户端模型的有效性，实现了加密兼容的基于元数据的聚类，在CFL三难困境中获得了更优的定位。

Conclusion: FLAMECHE成功解决了基于元数据的CFL方法无法与标准FL隐私保护机制兼容的问题，通过EM重构和加法操作的设计，在隐私、通信和计算效率三个维度上实现了更优的平衡，拓展了CFL的实际应用前景。

Abstract: Clustered Federated Learning (CFL) addresses data heterogeneity in federated settings by grouping clients with similar data distributions to enable effective training. Existing methods face a trade-off between privacy preservation, communication cost, and computational efficiency. We formalize this as the CFL trilemma, according to which improving two of these dimensions comes at the expense of the third. A prominent paradigm relies on metadata (i.e., low-dimensional representations of client datasets shared with the server) to enable communication- and computation-efficient clustering. However, such approaches are not compatible with standard FL privacy-preserving mechanisms. To address this limitation, we propose FLAMECHE, which reformulates metadata-based CFL as a distributed Expectation-Maximization (EM) procedure, restricting server updates to additive operations while preserving efficiency. This design enables compatibility with practical secure FL schemes. We conducted extensive experiments on multiple datasets under various heterogeneous scenarios. Results show that FLAMECHE improves the effectiveness of client models. It enables encryption-compatible metadata-based clustering, enhancing its positioning within the CFL trilemma.

</details>


### [285] [LEDGERMIND: Provenance-Constrained Multimodal Agentic Reasoning with a Structured Evidence Ledger](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28374)
*Enjun Du,Hange Zhou,Chenxu Du,Siyi Liu,Zirong Chen,Ziyu Zheng,Yongqi Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LedgerMind框架，将多模态智能体轨迹建模为受溯源约束的状态机，通过结构化证据账本、三层接地协议、自适应双路径调度器和事件触发验证-修复引擎，同时提升答案准确性和轨迹级忠实度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉问答多模态智能体评估仅依赖最终答案准确率，无法区分正确答案是通过有据证据、语言先验还是错误抵消获得的，且最终准确率会掩盖四类反复出现的失败模式：无依据的中间推理、引用式实体幻觉、简单查询上的过度推理以及修复阶段的放大问题。

Method: 将多模态智能体轨迹视为受溯源约束的状态机：(1) 工具输出归一化为结构化证据账本作为轨迹状态；(2) 下游推理和决策只能引用活跃账本条目；(3) 在实体和数值层面检查接地性；(4) 修复通过类型化状态转换实现，不能引入无工具溯源的内容。在此基础上构建LedgerMind，包含三层接地协议、自适应双路径调度器（根据问题复杂度匹配推理深度）以及具备形式化溯源非放大保证的事件触发验证-修复引擎。

Result: 在多个多模态推理基准和多种骨干MLLM上的实验表明，LedgerMind在答案准确性和轨迹级忠实度两方面均取得了改进。

Conclusion: 通过溯源约束的状态机设计，可以同时改善多模态智能体的最终答案质量与推理过程的可信度，揭示并解决最终准确率指标所掩盖的系统性缺陷。

Abstract: Multimodal agents for visual question answering increasingly operate as multi-step trajectories that interleave perception, retrieval, and reasoning, yet evaluation still largely reduces to final-answer accuracy. This aggregate signal cannot tell whether a correct answer was reached through grounded evidence, language priors, or accidental error cancellation. We propose to treat a multimodal agent trajectory as a provenance-constrained state machine: tool outputs are normalized into a Structured Evidence Ledger that serves as the trajectory state, downstream reasoning and decision claims may cite only active ledger entries, grounding is checked at the entity and numeric level, and repair is realized as typed state transitions that cannot introduce content without tool-produced provenance. We instantiate this design as LedgerMind (Provenance-Constrained Multimodal Agentic Reasoning with a Structured Evidence Ledger), augmented by a Three-Layer Grounding Protocol, an Adaptive Dual-Path Dispatcher that matches reasoning depth to question complexity, and an Event-Triggered Verification-and-Repair engine with a formal provenance non-amplification guarantee. We use LedgerMind to target four recurring failure patterns that final-answer accuracy tends to obscure: unsupported intermediate reasoning, citation-backed entity hallucination (Phantom Grounding), over-reasoning on simple queries, and repair-time amplification. Experiments across multiple multimodal reasoning benchmarks and backbone MLLMs show that LedgerMind improves both answer accuracy and trajectory-level faithfulness.

</details>


### [286] [Hierarchical Multilevel Monte Carlo for Order-Optimal Neural Actor-Critic in Average-Reward CMDPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28390)
*Ankur Naskar,Vaneet Aggarwal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了基于分层多级蒙特卡洛（MLMC）神经评论家的原始-对偶自然演员-评论家算法，解决了平均奖励约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）中神经评论家估计的偏差-成本权衡问题，首次实现了最优阶收敛保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在安全关键应用中，CMDP是强化学习的自然框架。虽然线性评论家的原始-对偶演员-评论家方法已被充分理解，但将最优阶收敛保证扩展到平均奖励CMDP中的神经评论家仍是一个开放问题。主要挑战在于神经评论家估计中存在根本性的偏差-成本权衡：在NTK分析下，减少评论家偏差会大幅增加优化成本，阻碍原始-对偶框架中的最优阶收敛。

Method: 引入分层多级蒙特卡洛（MLMC）神经评论家，在轨迹采样和评论家优化两个层面同时进行去偏。该估计器以对数级期望采样成本获得长评论家优化运行的偏差。在此估计器基础上，开发了原始-对偶自然演员-评论家算法。

Result: 该算法实现了最优性差距和约束违反均为O~(T^{-1/2})阶，首次为无限时域平均奖励CMDP提供了一般策略参数化和神经评论家的最优阶收敛保证，且无需知道底层混合时间。结果在无约束场景下也具有新颖性。

Conclusion: 通过MLMC神经评论家解决了CMDP中神经批评者的偏差-成本瓶颈，建立了首个适用于无限时域平均奖励CMDP的原始-对偶最优阶收敛理论。

Abstract: Constrained Markov Decision Processes (CMDPs) provide a natural framework for reinforcement learning in safety-critical applications, where agents maximize long-term reward while satisfying long-term constraints. Although primal-dual actor-critic methods with linear critics are well understood, extending order-optimal convergence guarantees to neural critics in average-reward CMDPs has remained open. The main challenge is a fundamental bias-cost trade-off in neural critic estimation: under Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) analysis, reducing critic bias substantially increases critic optimization cost, preventing order-optimal convergence in the primal-dual framework. We resolve this bottleneck by introducing a hierarchical Multilevel Monte Carlo (MLMC) neural critic that performs debiasing simultaneously across trajectory sampling and critic optimization. The resulting estimator attains the bias of a long critic optimization run with only logarithmic expected sample cost. Building on this estimator, we develop a primal-dual Natural Actor-Critic algorithm that achieves both an optimality gap and a constraint violation of order $\tilde{O}(T^{-1/2})$. This establishes the first order-optimal convergence guarantees for infinite-horizon average-reward CMDPs with general policy parameterization and neural critics, while eliminating the need to know the underlying mixing time. Our results are novel even in the unconstrained setting.

</details>


### [287] [Why Are GUI Agents Correct but Late? Decode on the Decision-Time Critical Path, Tested with Pre-Compiled Policy Trees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28399)
*Zihan Dong,Rui Qian,Qishi Zhan,Dongshen Peng,Kaixin Li,Yu Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出自适应预期策略树（AAPT），一种无需修改底层模型即可消除GUI智能体在瞬态事件决策关键路径上解码延迟的方法。AAPT利用空闲屏幕时段，让同一个冻结的多模态模型预先构建带观察守卫、预授权动作和分支期限的有界条件策略树，事件发生时通过轻量观察者匹配变更门控帧并立即执行对应动作，无需生成新文本。配对试验中成功率从0.50提升至0.79（p=1.8×10⁻³），且不产生错误动作；在独立多模态模型和外部基准上均复现效果。AAPT在可预先枚举候选动作的场景表现最佳，而在无法预枚举时反应式执行更强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GUI智能体经常在瞬态GUI事件上失败，因为它们在决策关键路径上进行昂贵的自回归解码，导致产生正确动作时相关窗口已经关闭。作者识别出主要原因是决策时关键路径上的解码延迟，并希望消除这种延迟而不修改底层模型。

Method: AAPT的核心思路是利用屏幕空闲时段，让冻结的多模态模型预先构建一个有界条件策略树，该树包含可观察守卫、预授权动作和分支特定期限，树的规模覆盖模型自身的解码延迟。当事件发生时，一个轻量级观察者将变更门控帧与已准备的策略分支匹配，并立即执行对应动作，无需生成新文本。作者还进行了消融实验和预注册oracle探针来验证各组件的作用。

Result: 配对试验中，AAPT将成功率从0.50提升至0.79（p=1.8×10⁻³），且无错误动作。开放循环和预测-重规划基线因仍在执行中解码而成功率为零。预注册oracle探针否定了初始假设，指向分支路由（branch routing）为因果瓶颈。在独立通用多模态模型上，126次配对试验中复现效果（p=4.9×10⁻¹³）。外部基准上与反应式基线整体性能相当，但两者优势互补。

Conclusion: AAPT在候选动作可预先枚举时表现最佳，而反应式执行在无法预枚举时更强。AAPT的核心优势在于将解码延迟从决策关键路径中移除，通过预构建策略树实现即时响应，但分支路由准确性是其主要瓶颈，需要进一步优化。

Abstract: Computer-use agents often fail on transient GUI events because they produce the correct action only after the relevant window has already closed. We identify the main cause as expensive autoregressive decoding on the decision-time critical path. We propose Adaptive Anticipatory Policy Trees (AAPT), which eliminates this delay without modifying the underlying model. During idle screen periods, the same frozen multimodal model constructs a bounded conditional policy tree with observable guards, pre-authorized actions, and branch-specific deadlines. The tree is sized to cover the model's own decoding latency. When an event occurs, a lightweight observer matches change-gated frames to a prepared branch and immediately executes the corresponding action without generating new text. In paired trials with pre-registered endpoints and exact McNemar tests, AAPT improves the success rate from 0.50 to 0.79 within a contested decision window ($p=1.8\times10^{-3}$), while producing no incorrect actions. Both open-loop and predict-and-replan baselines achieve zero success because they still decode during execution. A preparation-time sweep shows that the gain emerges where the latency-based tree-sizing rule predicts, and ablations reveal three key requirements: fast observer decoding, valid tree planning, and accurate branch routing. A pre-registered oracle probe rejects our initial hypothesis and instead points to branch routing as the causal bottleneck. We further reproduce the effect on an independent general-purpose multimodal model over 126 paired trials ($p=4.9\times10^{-13}$). On an external benchmark, AAPT matches the overall performance of a reactive baseline, although the two methods exhibit complementary strengths. Together, these results suggest that AAPT performs best when candidate actions can be enumerated in advance, whereas reactive execution remains stronger when they cannot.

</details>


### [288] [On-Policy and Off-Policy Learning for Large Action Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28408)
*Imad Aouali*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究大规模动作空间下上下文赌博机的策略学习，涵盖在策略学习与离线策略学习两大范式，提出了基于贝叶斯方法（meTS、dTS）用于在策略学习，以及结构化直接方法（sDM）、凹的可优化目标、可微悲观方法用于离线策略学习，有效解决探索效率、方差控制与优化困难等问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在大规模动作空间中，上下文赌博机的策略学习面临多方面的重大挑战：在策略学习中的低效探索和数据覆盖不足，以及离线策略学习中的高方差重要性权重、外推偏差和困难的优化景观。这些问题限制了现有方法在真实场景中的适用性。

Method: 论文分为两部分。在策略学习方面，提出meTS（混合效应Thompson采样）和dTS（基于扩散启发式先验的Thompson采样），通过共享动作间信息并以有效动作数来刻画遗憾界。离线策略学习方面，提出基于潜变量的结构化直接方法sDM；证明优化误差在大动作空间中可主导估计误差，并引入凹的、可高效优化的策略加权对数似然目标；最后基于指数平滑和PAC-Bayesian界发展可微悲观方法，以控制正则化重要性采样估计器的偏差-方差权衡。

Result: meTS和dTS方法能够跨动作共享信息，其遗憾保障以有效动作数为参数而非全动作空间规模；离线学习方面，揭示了优化误差在大动作空间的支配性，提出可解析优化的凹目标以及可微悲观估计器来控制偏差-方差权衡。

Conclusion: 论文系统性地解决了大规模动作空间下的策略学习问题，从在策略和离线两个范式分别提出了结构化的贝叶斯与悲观方法，在理论上给出了可扩展的遗憾界和估计误差分析，为实际应用中的大规模推荐和决策系统提供了坚实的理论基础。

Abstract: This thesis studies policy learning in interactive systems where an agent observes a context, selects an action from a very large set, and receives partial feedback. The main framework is contextual bandits, with two paradigms: on-policy learning, where the agent interacts sequentially with the environment and minimizes regret, and off-policy learning, where it learns from logged data collected by a logging policy. In large action spaces, both settings face major challenges: inefficient exploration, sparse data coverage, high-variance importance weights, extrapolation bias, and difficult optimization landscapes. The first part develops structured Bayesian methods for on-policy learning. We introduce meTS, a mixed-effect extension of Thompson sampling, and dTS, which leverages diffusion-inspired priors to model dependencies between actions. These methods share information across actions and yield regret guarantees depending on an effective number of actions. The second part addresses off-policy learning. We propose sDM, a structured direct method based on latent variables, show that optimization error can dominate estimation error in large action spaces, and introduce concave, efficiently optimizable policy-weighted log-likelihood objectives. Finally, we develop differentiable pessimistic methods based on exponential smoothing and PAC-Bayesian bounds to control the bias-variance trade-off of regularized importance-sampling estimators.

</details>


### [289] [QQWorld: Quantile-Quantile Matching for World Model Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28415)
*Zhoushun Yu,Xiaoyu Hu,Xiangyu Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出QQWorld，用分位数-分位数匹配目标替代Epps-Pulley正则化，以解决潜世界模型（LeWM）中EP目标对重尾样本纠正不足的问题，从而改善潜变量分布的高斯对齐质量并提升规划成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜世界模型的性能依赖于学习到的潜变量分布质量。LeWM使用Epps-Pulley目标将潜变量正则化到各向同性高斯分布，但EP目标的纠正梯度对于孤立的尾部样本会迅速消失，导致重尾偏差得不到有效控制，进而影响规划性能。

Method: 提出QQWorld，用分位数-分位数（QQ）匹配目标取代EP目标，直接将投影后的潜变量样本与按秩匹配的高斯分位数对齐，从而在尾部保持有效的纠正梯度。还提出跨批次QQ（cross-batch QQ）机制，利用先前批次的分离样本扩大有效排序池，并分析了该机制的偏差-方差权衡。

Result: 在四个控制环境中，QQWorld有效提升了LeWM的平均规划成功率，同时持续获得更好的高斯对齐效果和更薄的潜变量尾部。

Conclusion: QQWorld通过直接的分位数匹配正则化改善了潜世界模型的潜变量分布质量，验证了QQ目标相比EP目标在尾部正则化上的优势。

Abstract: Latent world models enable efficient planning by predicting future states in a compact representation space, but their performance depends critically on the quality of the learned latent distribution. LeWorldModel (LeWM) regularizes its latents toward an isotropic Gaussian using the Epps-Pulley (EP) objective. We show that the corrective gradients of EP rapidly vanish for isolated tail samples, leaving heavy-tailed deviations insufficiently controlled. To address this limitation, we propose QQWorld, which replaces EP with a quantile-quantile matching objective that directly aligns projected latent samples with rank-matched Gaussian quantiles, thereby maintaining effective corrective gradients in the tails. We further develop cross-batch QQ, which enlarges the effective ranking pool using detached samples from previous batches, and characterize its bias-variance trade-off. Across four control environments, QQWorld effectively improves the average planning success rate of LeWM, while consistently yielding better Gaussian alignment and thinner latent tails.

</details>


### [290] [QAdapt: A Noise-Adaptive Neural Pre-Decoding Framework for Quantum Error Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28422)
*Ran Miao,Rui Luo,Xiaohan Shan,Xiaoming Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出QAdapt，一个噪声自适应的神经预解码框架，用于表面码量子纠错。它捕获综合征数据中的局部时空相关性，顺序适应动态噪声条件并缓解灾难性遗忘，将残余综合征转发给传统全局解码器。在110种合成分布外噪声配置上持续降低逻辑错误率，在Google Willow基准数据上无需目标域微调即可实现逻辑错误率降低5.79%、后端解码延迟降低9.32%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 容错量子计算（FTQC）的性能不仅受物理噪声制约，还受经典解码器处理快速产生的综合征数据时的延迟限制。硬件噪声具有强、异构、非平稳的特性，且模拟到硬件的分布偏移会显著退化固定神经解码器的性能，因此需要一种能自适应动态噪声条件的解码方案。

Method: QAdapt是一个噪声自适应的神经预解码框架，包含三个关键组件：（1）捕获综合征数据中的局部时空相关性；（2）通过顺序适应机制动态调整以应对变化的噪声条件，同时采用缓解灾难性遗忘的策略；（3）将预解码后的残余综合征转发给传统全局解码器完成最终解码。

Result: 在110种合成的分布外噪声配置下（针对旋转表面码存储电路），QAdapt相较于神经预解码基线一致地降低了逻辑错误率。在Google Willow基准数据上，无需目标域微调，逻辑错误率降低达5.79%，残余综合征的后端解码延迟降低达9.32%。

Conclusion: QAdapt提供了一种实用且与解码器兼容的方法，能够提升量子纠错在演化硬件噪声条件下的鲁棒性和后端解码效率，对实际容错量子计算的部署具有重要价值。

Abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC) relies on quantum error correction to suppress physical errors and preserve logical information at scale. In practice, however, performance is constrained not only by physical noise but also by the latency of classical decoders processing rapidly generated syndrome data. This challenge is exacerbated by hardware noise that is strong, heterogeneous, and nonstationary, as well as by the simulation-to-hardware distribution shift that can substantially degrade fixed neural decoders. We present QAdapt, a noise-adaptive neural pre-decoding framework for surface-code quantum error correction. QAdapt captures local spatiotemporal correlations in syndrome data, sequentially adapts to evolving noise conditions while mitigating catastrophic forgetting, and forwards the residual syndrome to a conventional global decoder. Across 110 synthetic out-of-distribution noise configurations for rotated surface-code memory circuits, QAdapt consistently reduces the logical error rate relative to the neural pre-decoding baseline. On Google's Willow benchmark data, without target-domain fine-tuning, it achieves reductions of up to 5.79 percent in logical error rate and 9.32 percent in backend decoding latency on the residual syndrome. These results demonstrate that QAdapt provides a practical and decoder-compatible approach to improving the robustness and backend decoding efficiency of quantum error correction under evolving hardware noise.

</details>


### [291] [Oracle-Budgeted Molecular Optimization with Short-Term Graph Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28437)
*Jiannan Yang,Veronika Thost,Xiang Ling,Tengfei Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为"短期图记忆"的即插即用模块，通过在生成器中引入在线图神经网络代理来预筛选候选分子，从而在有限的预算下更有效地分配oracle查询，提高分子优化性能且不额外增加oracle成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子优化通常在有限的oracle预算下进行，决定评估哪些分子与决定生成哪些分子同样重要。现有方法关注改进生成器本身，但忽略了如何更智能地筛选候选分子以最大化有限预算的利用效率。

Method: 提出短期图记忆模块：它是一个即插即用的组件，保持生成器架构和原生更新规则不变，通过在线图神经网络对每轮候选池进行预筛选，使有限的oracle预算优先分配给预测效用更高的分子。

Result: 在标准分子优化基准上应用于片段生成器时，平均top-10分数得到提升且不增加oracle成本，在任何oracle上都不落后于基线；在1000次调用的紧凑预算下，收益扩展到所有测试的四种生成器。分析表明其收益与骨干生成器的搜索广度和原生搜索对oracle反馈的利用能力相关。

Conclusion: 提供了一种简单有效的方式在固定oracle预算下更选择性分配资源，并给出了哪些生成器能从该模块中获益的依据。

Abstract: Molecular optimization is commonly performed under a limited oracle budget, which makes deciding what to evaluate as important as deciding what to generate. We introduce short-term graph memory, a plug-in module that preserves the generator architecture and native update rule while learning from previously evaluated molecules to prioritize subsequent oracle queries. The module maintains an online graph neural surrogate that pre-screens each round's candidate pool, so the fixed oracle budget is spent on molecules with higher predicted utility. Applied to a fragment-based generator on a standard molecular optimization benchmark, it improves the mean top-10 score at no extra oracle cost and never falls behind the base on any oracle; the gain extends to all four generators we tested at a tight budget of one thousand calls. We then analyze how surrogate-guided selection interacts with the exploration and exploitation behavior of different generators. Its benefit at larger budgets is consistent with two properties of the backbone: how broadly it searches, and how effectively its native search already exploits oracle feedback. We provide a simple way to spend a fixed oracle budget more selectively, and evidence on which generators benefit from it.

</details>


### [292] [Cybersecurity Detection Classification with Reasoning-enabled Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28460)
*Amol Khanna,Manu Nandan,Cristian Viorel Popa,Joan Pujol-Roig,Diana Bolocan,Laura Vasilie,Alexandru Apostu,Chase Helwig,Mihaela Gaman,Michael Brautbar,Edward Raff,Chase Midler,Sven Krasser*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于链式思维（CoT）推理的安全运营中心（SOC）告警分流分类器，结合自动提示优化、自训练和可验证奖励的强化学习，并额外训练一个校准器来估计推理轨迹的置信度。系统达到82.6%的测试准确率，在高置信度操作点下，良性召回率提升43.0%，恶意召回率提升18.3%，远超直接标签的LLM分类器和前沿通用模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SOC中存在严重的告警疲劳问题，检测数量超过人工分流能力。现有方法直接提示或微调LLM输出分流标签，但未训练模型推理检测是否为真实威胁，导致判别能力不足。

Method: 在真实的人类标注的Windows端点检测数据上，训练一个具备CoT推理能力的分流分类器。训练流程结合了自动化提示优化、自训练以及带可验证奖励的强化学习。此外，由于CoT推理会降低直接依赖标签token概率的分流可靠性，作者单独训练了一个校准器，读取完整推理轨迹并估计判定正确的概率。

Result: 系统达到82.6%的测试准确率；在高置信度操作点下，良性召回率提升43.0%，恶意召回率提升18.3%（相比直接标签LLM分类器）。实验还表明训练的校准器不可或缺——未训练的置信度判断器会将高置信度召回率降至零；同时，微调的30B模型显著优于前沿通用模型，说明定向训练比单纯扩大模型规模更有效。

Conclusion: CoT推理与专门的校准机制相结合，能显著提升LLM在SOC告警分流任务上的有效性；定向微调的较小模型在特定安全领域任务上可超越更大规模的通用前沿模型。

Abstract: A major issue in Security Operations Centers (SOCs) is alert fatigue, as the number of detections reported is more than staff can triage in a given day. Prior work prompts or fine-tunes large language models (LLMs) to emit a triage label directly, but does not train them to reason about whether a detection is a genuine threat. We train a chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning-enabled triage classifier on real, human-labeled Windows endpoint detections by combining automated prompt optimization, self-training, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. We find that CoT reasoning also degrades the label-token probabilities that automated triage relies on, so we separately train a calibrator that reads the full reasoning trace and estimates the probability that the verdict is correct. Our system reaches 82.6% test accuracy and, at the high-confidence operating point that governs automated triage, improves benign recall by 43.0% and malicious recall by 18.3% over a direct-label LLM classifier. We further show that the trained calibrator is necessary - an untrained confidence judge collapses high-confidence recall to zero - and that a finetuned 30B model significantly outperforms frontier general-purpose models, motivating targeted training over scale.

</details>


### [293] [Same Graph Cross-Task Transfer in GNNs: Protocols and Predictors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28525)
*Neelam Akula,Surbhi Kumar,Murat Kantarcioglu,Baris Coskunuzer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文形式化了同图上的节点分类（NC）与链接预测（LP）之间的迁移学习问题，提出了一种无泄漏的评估协议，并在三个骨干网络上发现NC→LP在同质图上始终有益，而LP→NC仅在结构主导、LP容易且NC未饱和时才可靠有益。文章还提出了CoTask Score（CTS）来评估共享编码器同时服务两个任务的联合效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实中的许多图数据需要在同一底层结构上支持多个预测任务（节点分类和链接预测），这为跨任务复用监督信号提供了机会。然而现有评估常使用不相容的数据划分、不同的观测图假设和不同的负采样规则，导致关于同图跨任务迁移的结论不可靠。需要一个统一、无泄漏的评测框架来系统研究这一迁移现象。

Method: 本文提出：(1) 形式化定义同图NC-LP迁移问题；(2) 设计无泄漏评测协议，固定节点和边的划分，使用排除被评估边的共享消息传递图，并对LP采用固定负样本；(3) 在GCN、GraphSAGE、GPS三个骨干网络上进行系统实验；(4) 引入CoTask Score (CTS)来量化共享编码器同时服务NC和LP时的联合效用，并利用同质性等简单数据集统计特征来指导选择适当的迁移机制。

Result: 研究发现迁移具有强烈的方向性和可预测性：NC→LP在同质图上始终有益；LP→NC则较为脆弱，简单的表示重用甚至可能降低准确率。LP→NC只有在结构主导（LP容易但NC未饱和）的情况下才可靠地产生正面收益，表明LP在这里扮演了结构预训练的角色。同质性等数据集统计量可以有效指导机制选择并避免负面迁移。

Conclusion: 跨任务迁移在同图NC-LP之间是可行的但具有方向性，需要根据数据集属性（如同质性）谨慎选择迁移方向。CTS评分能有效总结共享编码器的联合任务效用，简单的数据集统计特征即可指导实践者避免负面迁移。

Abstract: Many real-world graphs support multiple predictive tasks over the same underlying structure, creating an opportunity to reuse supervision across node classification (NC) and link prediction (LP). However, existing evaluations often rely on incompatible splits, observed-graph assumptions, and negative sampling rules, making conclusions about same-graph cross-task transfer unreliable. We formalize same-graph NC-LP transfer and propose a leakage-free protocol that fixes node and edge splits, uses a shared message-passing graph that excludes evaluated edges, and employs fixed negatives for LP. Across three backbones (GCN, GraphSAGE, GPS), we find that transfer is strongly directional and predictable: NC $\to$ LP is consistently beneficial on homophilic graphs, while LP $\to$ NC is fragile and can even degrade accuracy under naive representation reuse. LP $\to$ NC becomes reliably positive mainly in a structure-dominant regime where LP is easy but NC is unsaturated, suggesting that LP acts as structural pretraining. Finally, we introduce the CoTask Score (CTS) to summarize joint NC+LP utility when a shared encoder must serve both tasks, and show that simple dataset statistics, especially homophily, can guide mechanism choice and help avoid negative transfer.

</details>


### [294] [APO: Unsupervised Atomic Policy Optimization for 3D Structure Prediction of Atomic Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28553)
*Shentong Mo,Yatao Bian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出APO（Atomic Policy Optimization），一种完全无监督的3D原子结构对齐框架，通过群相对策略优化结合双奖励机制（潜在结构模式奖励和热力学稳定性奖励），无需真实参考坐标即可实现结构预测，在晶体和抗体结构预测上超越全监督基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的流匹配模型（如FlowDPO）在3D结构预测中依赖监督偏好学习，需要与真实坐标对齐，但获取新颖晶体相或从头设计蛋白的实验标签成本极高，数据稀缺场景下形成瓶颈。因此需要无需地面真值参考结构的无监督对齐方法。

Method: APO将群相对策略优化（GRPO）适配到3D原子环境，提出双奖励机制：（1）基于样本相似性特征分解的特征奖励，强化策略的主导潜在结构模态；（2）热力学稳定性奖励。通过识别采样组内物理合理构象实现模型的自我纠正。

Result: 在晶体和抗体结构预测的广泛基准测试中，APO一致性地超越全监督基线，在匹配率和结构保真度上达到新的最先进水平。此外，APO有效拉直了概率路径，显著提升了推理效率。

Conclusion: 内在物理一致性相比有噪声的监督坐标匹配是更优的对齐指导信号，表明无监督物理引导的对齐方法在结构预测中具有巨大潜力。

Abstract: Predicting the 3D structures of atomic systems is fundamental to advancing material science and drug discovery. While flow-matching models (, FlowDPO) have recently shown promise in this domain, their performance relies heavily on alignment with ground-truth coordinates via supervised preference learning. However, obtaining experimental labels for novel crystal phases or de novo proteins is prohibitively expensive, creating a bottleneck for structural modeling in data-scarce regimes. In this work, we propose (Atomic Policy Optimization), a fully unsupervised alignment framework that eliminates the need for ground-truth reference structures. APO adapts group-relative policy optimization to 3D atomic environments, utilizing a novel dual-reward mechanism: (i) a that reinforces the policy's dominant latent structural modes through eigen-decomposition of sample similarities, and (ii) a that enforces thermodynamic stability. Our framework enables the model to ``self-correct'' by identifying physically plausible configurations within sampled groups. Extensive benchmarks on crystal and antibody structure prediction demonstrate that APO consistently outperforms fully supervised baselines, achieving a new state-of-the-art in match rates and structural fidelity. Furthermore, we show that APO effectively straightens probability paths, significantly improving inference efficiency. Our results suggest that intrinsic physical consistency can serve as a superior guide for alignment compared to noisy, supervised coordinate matching.

</details>


### [295] [$β$-OPSD: Deriving with Policy Optimization, Training with Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28582)
*Jiawei Xu,Minghui Liu,Juzheng Zhang,Tom Goldstein,Furong Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出β-OPSD，将vanilla OPSD泛化为可控的KL正则化策略优化家族，通过logit混合实现参考策略与privileged teacher之间的几何插值蒸馏目标，在数学推理基准上显著提升优化稳定性和推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Vanilla on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) 在实践中的优化过程脆弱且不稳定，需要大量工程调优。作者识别出这一困难的根源：vanilla OPSD恰好是广义策略优化家族中β=1的特例，而β本应作为可调的正则化参数来控制学生策略与参考策略之间的KL距离，从而在参考策略锚定与privileged teacher引导之间取得更好的平衡。

Method: (1) 从理论上证明vanilla OPSD是β=1的β-OPSD特例，并推导出β-OPSD的最优策略为参考策略与privileged teacher之间的几何插值；(2) 避免直接优化高方差且昂贵的RL目标，而是将闭环解转化为蒸馏目标，通过在token-level对参考策略和teacher的logits进行混合来实现不同β值对应的目标；(3) 引入return-to-go credit assignment，使token更新与序列级目标对齐，同时保持OPSD的简单性。

Result: 在数学推理基准上的实验表明，β-OPSD一致性地优于vanilla OPSD，显著改善了优化稳定性，并提升了下游推理性能。

Conclusion: β-OPSD提供了一条从自蒸馏到策略优化的原则性路径，在不牺牲OPSD实用效率的前提下，通过可调β参数实现了更稳定、更优的推理模型优化。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) is a promising approach to improve reasoning language models, but it remains brittle in practice: making it work reliably often requires substantial engineering effort. We identify a structural source of this difficulty: vanilla OPSD is precisely the $β=1$ member of a broader policy-optimization family, where $β$ weights the KL penalty anchoring the student to a reference policy. This equivalence turns $β$ from an implicit value fixed at one into a controllable regularization parameter, yielding a more general formulation that trades off proximity to a reference policy against privileged teacher guidance. We introduce $β$-OPSD and derive its optimal policy as a geometric interpolation between the reference policy and the privileged teacher. Directly optimizing this objective with reinforcement learning, however, would be costly and high-variance. Rather than optimize the RL objective directly, we turn its closed-form solution into a distillation target. Each value of $β$ selects a target along the reference-to-teacher path, which we implement efficiently by mixing their token-level logits. In this way, inexpensive distillation approximates the solution of expensive policy optimization. Return-to-go credit assignment further aligns token updates with the sequence-level objective while retaining the simplicity of OPSD. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that $β$-OPSD consistently outperforms vanilla OPSD, improving optimization stability and downstream reasoning performance. Our results provide a principled route from self-distillation to policy optimization and back without sacrificing the efficiency that makes OPSD practical.

</details>


### [296] [KAISEN: Reproducible Subgroup Fairness Auditing for Clinical Risk Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28608)
*Sparsh Roy,Samuel Girmachew,Nishita Chavan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出KAISEN，一个包含五阶段（子群分层、差异度量、机制诊断、事后缓解、漂移监测）的临床模型审计流水线，并在合成基准（16种疾病任务、15个社会决定因素轴、3个预设交叉）上将其评估至失败点。研究发现：显著性追踪需按最小可检测效应标准化；按组阈值优化稳定降低EOD但Platt缩放不起作用；机制诊断在受控情况下完美但在代理误设下完全失效且无失败信号；CUSUM警报与队列实现高度相关而非疾病本身。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床风险模型在总体表现上很强，但在不同患者子群间错误率存在实质性差异。虽然已有审计流水线用于检测此类问题，但其各组件很少被压力测试，导致不清楚哪些部分可被信任及在何种条件下可用。

Method: 构建KAISEN五阶段审计流水线（子群分层、差异度量、机制诊断、事后缓解、漂移监测），在合成基准上评估至失败点。基准包含16个疾病任务、15个来自Healthy People 2030的社会决定因素轴和3个预设交叉。使用错误发现、假设检验、校准比较等方法进行系统性压力测试。

Result: 四项主要发现：(i) 显著性计数与原始EOD的秩相关为rho=0.56，用最小可检测效应标准化后升至rho=0.78。(ii) 按组阈值优化在48/48次运行中降低EOD（均值差-0.285），而组级Platt缩放仅改善19/48次（均值效应接近零）。(iii) 机制诊断在144个受控案例中全部正确分类，但在代理误设下48个模型驱动案例全部无法恢复且无失败信号。(iv) CUSUM阈值参考下27个假警报和7/8个漏检来自不同种子（卡方p=0.002），阈值不可跨队列迁移。

Conclusion: 审计流水线的各组件都有明确的失败模式：显著性必须按各自最小可检测效应解读；缓解方法应报告方差而非平均值；机制诊断对代理误设高度脆弱且无失败提示；漂移监测的阈值不可跨队列迁移。所有结果为合成数据，具备已知真实标签，不构成临床有效性的证明。

Abstract: Clinical risk models routinely achieve strong aggregate performance while producing materially different error rates across patient subgroups. Audit pipelines have been proposed to catch this, but their components are rarely stress-tested, so it is unclear which parts of an audit can be trusted and under what conditions. We present KAISEN, a five-phase audit pipeline covering subgroup stratification, disparity measurement, mechanism diagnostics, post-hoc mitigation, and drift monitoring, evaluated to the point of failure on a synthetic benchmark of 16 disease tasks, 15 social-determinant axes from Healthy People 2030, and three prespecified intersections. Four findings follow. (i) Significance tracks each axis's gap against its own minimum detectable effect: rank correlation between significance count and raw equalized-odds difference (EOD) across the 15 axes is rho = 0.56, rising to rho = 0.78 once EOD is standardized by that floor. (ii) Per-group threshold optimization reduces EOD in 48 of 48 held-out runs (paired delta = -0.285, 95% CI [-0.313, -0.252]), while group-wise Platt scaling -- the better calibrator -- behaves as a coin flip on EOD (19 of 48 runs improved, 95% CI [0.26, 0.55]) with mean effect near zero, so what an audit should report is the variance, not the average. (iii) The mechanism diagnostic classifies 144 of 144 controlled cases correctly but recovers none of 48 model-driven cases under proxy misspecification, with no signal that it failed. (iv) CUSUM failures and false alarms track cohort realization far more than disease: at the reference threshold, all 27 false alarms and 7 of 8 missed shifts come from different seeds (chi-squared p = 0.002), so a threshold tuned on one cohort fails to transfer. All results are synthetic with known ground truth and do not establish clinical validity. Code, artifacts, and scripts reproducing every number are released.

</details>

### [297] [Compact Representation of Mipmapped SVBRDFs via Shared Gaussians](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27943)
*Fengdi Zhang,Haocheng Ren,Qing Luo,Yaqing Li,Jibing Lou,Hongwei Li*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: 本文提出Gaussian Texture Compression (GTC)，一种基于2D高斯的紧凑表示方法，用于压缩mipmapped SVBRDF纹理堆栈，通过跨mip级别和材质图共享高斯足迹，实现了比ASTC更高的重建质量和更低的内存占用，同时支持随机访问和非神经解码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SVBRDF纹理的高分辨率、多通道、mipmapped特性导致存储负担沉重。现有压缩方法存在权衡困境：块压缩只能利用局部冗余，图像编解码器不支持实时纹理访问，神经纹理压缩需要推理开销。需要一种兼顾压缩率、随机访问和实时解码的新方案。

Method: GTC利用SVBRDF纹理堆栈中的两类冗余（跨mip级别和跨材质图），基于2D高斯表示将空间足迹与携带的值显式分离，共享高斯足迹而让值随级别和材质图变化。通过渐进优化流程训练，生成紧凑的2D高斯基表示。

Result: 在重建质量和内存使用上优于工业标准的ASTC GPU纹理压缩格式，同时保持随机访问和非神经解码能力，适用于实时渲染。

Conclusion: GTC通过利用数据中的结构性冗余（跨mip级别和跨材质图共享空间支持），在压缩率、重建质量和实时解码之间取得更优平衡，为SVBRDF纹理压缩提供了一种实用的替代方案。

Abstract: Spatially-varying BRDFs (SVBRDFs) are central to material representation in computer graphics, but their high-resolution, multi-channel, mipmapped textures impose a substantial storage burden. Existing compression methods face a fundamental trade-off: block-based compression provides random access and hardware-friendly decoding but exploits redundancy only within local blocks; image codecs offer strong rate-distortion performance but are not designed for direct real-time texture access; and neural texture compression achieves high compression ratios but requires neural inference during decoding, which introduces additional runtime overhead, especially on mobile platforms. We present Gaussian Texture Compression (GTC), a compact 2D Gaussian-based representation for mipmapped SVBRDF texture stacks that delivers high-quality compression with flexible rate-distortion trade-offs. Our method is based on a key observation that there are two dominant sources of redundancy in such data: across mip levels and across material maps. Both share a common underlying structure: the same spatial support is reused, with only level- or map-specific information attached. This property naturally suits 2D Gaussians, since each Gaussian explicitly separates its spatial footprint from the values it carries, allowing the footprint to be shared while the values vary per level and per map. Building on this property, GTC shares Gaussians along both redundancy dimensions and is trained via a progressive optimization pipeline. Experiments show that GTC achieves higher reconstruction quality and lower memory usage than ASTC, the industry-standard GPU texture compression format, while supporting random-access, non-neural decoding suitable for real-time rendering.

</details>


### [298] [A Query-Efficient Stochastic Volume Rendering Framework for Time-Varying Implicit Neural Volumes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28047)
*Alper Sahistan,Haichao Miao,Zhimin Li,Peer-Timo Bremer,Joshua A Levine,Valerio Pascucci*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于delta tracking的查询高效随机体渲染框架，用于直接渲染时变隐式神经表示（INRs），在RTX 4090上实现1024x1024分辨率下约30-40 FPS的交互式渲染，且时间步更新仅需1-2毫秒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时变INRs是动态X射线CT等模态数据的紧凑且唯一的实用表示方式，但交互式体渲染面临挑战：传统密集采样的光线步进方法因廉价的显存查找被昂贵的神经推理替代而难以实用。重采样、缓存和重训练虽能缓解成本，但会牺牲便利性和精度，且在时变数据上不切实际。

Method: 提出一种基于delta tracking的查询高效随机体渲染框架，采用四阶段流水线利用异构并行：使用光线追踪核心（RT cores）进行遍历，使用张量核心（tensor cores）进行批处理神经评估。此外，通过光线预算（ray budgeting）和查询剪枝（query pruning）策略减少INR查询次数，提升每帧性能。

Result: 系统可直接从原始表示渲染多种时变INRs，在RTX 4090 GPU上以1024x1024分辨率实现约30-40 FPS，且能收敛到高保真图像。时间步更新约1-2毫秒，支持连续域内的交互式时域探索。

Conclusion: 该系统证明通过结合delta tracking随机采样策略与硬件加速的异构并行，可以大幅降低INR体渲染的神经推理开销，使时变INRs的交互式直接渲染成为可能，并支持流畅的时域连续探索。

Abstract: Time-varying implicit neural representations (INRs) provide a compact representation of scientific volumes and, for modalities such as dynamic X-ray computed tomography (CT), are often the only practical way to represent the data. However, interactive volume rendering of INRs is challenging, as cheap memory lookups are replaced by expensive neural inferences, hindering the performance. Therefore, conventional volume rendering methods such as ray marching with dense sampling are often impractical. While resampling, caching, and retraining can mitigate this cost, they compromise convenience and accuracy and become impractical for time-varying data. We tackle these challenges using a query-efficient stochastic volume rendering framework based on delta tracking. Our system employs a four-stage pipeline that exploits heterogeneous parallelism, using ray tracing cores for traversal and tensor cores for batched neural evaluation. Furthermore, we present strategies to reduce INR queries via ray budgeting and query pruning, thereby increasing per-frame performance. Using our renderer, many time-varying INRs can be rendered directly from their original representation. The system achieves ~30-40 FPS at 1024x1024 resolution on an RTX 4090 GPU and converges to high-fidelity images. Moreover, the system enables interactive temporal exploration of the continuous domain, with timestep updates taking approximately 1-2 ms.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [299] [Multi-Head Attention Residuals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27230)
*Cheng Luo,Zefan Cai,Junjie Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出多头注意力残差（MHAR），将路由查询重塑为H个逐子空间头，每个头在深度历史上独立进行softmax，从而让不同特征子空间拥有各自的深度读取分布。在100M/350M/1B规模的预训练中，MHAR一致优于标准Transformer及三种基线方法，并在8B规模的持续训练中带来下游任务提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准Transformer通过单一加性残差流传播信息，每个子层只能读取最新状态。注意力残差虽允许子层通过softmax读取深度历史，但使用单一共享查询，意味着所有特征子空间必须共用同一个深度历史读取分布。当子空间对"该读哪一层"的偏好不一致时，这种强制折中代价高昂，且随着模型宽度增加，子空间分歧加剧，问题更加严重。

Method: 将注意力残差中的路由查询重塑为H个逐子空间头，每个头拥有各自的深度历史softmax，使读取变为块对角结构。该重塑不增加参数量且计算开销可忽略。H=1时恰好退化为原始注意力残差。此外设计Fused Triton路由核以提升训练吞吐，并提出基于delta注意力残差的恒等保持转换以支持大规模持续训练。

Result: 在去重的Nemotron退火语料上，MHAR在100M、350M、1B规模上分别将验证损失降至-0.061、-0.149、-0.140。在四种方法中所有设置均取得最优结果，且优势随规模增大而扩大。H=4或H=8为最优，过分割（H=16）会回吐部分收益。Fused Triton内核将注意力残差训练吞吐从基线的0.2-0.5倍提升至0.55-0.88倍，峰值内存接近基线。8B持续训练在GSM8K上+3.2、在GPQA上+3.1。

Conclusion: MHAR验证了"子空间分歧"是注意力残差受限的内在原因，头数H是真实的设计维度而非自由旋钮。该方法在多个规模上一致优于基线，且通过工程优化和恒等转换方案具备扩展到大规模训练的实际可行性，8B规模的持续训练结果进一步验证了其有效性。

Abstract: Transformers propagate information across depth through a single additive residual stream: every sublayer reads only the most recent state. Attention residuals relax this by letting each sublayer attend, through a learned softmax. However, that read uses a single query shared across the entire width, so every feature subspace must read the depth history through one distribution. The cost of this forced compromise grows with how much the subspaces disagree about which layers to read, and disagreement grows with model width. We introduce Multi-Head Attention Residuals (MHAR): the routing query is reshaped into H per-subspace heads, each with its own softmax over the depth history. The read becomes block-diagonal, the reshape adds zero parameters and negligible compute, and H = 1 recovers attention residuals exactly. Trained from scratch on a deduplicated Nemotron-based anneal corpus that is quality-filtered and STEM- and code-heavy, MHAR improves validation loss over a standard Transformer at 100M, 350M, and 1B (-0.061, -0.149, and -0.140). It achieves the best result among four methods in every setting, with the gain increasing from 100M to the larger scales. The head count is a real design axis rather than a free knob: validation loss is U-shaped with respect to H, with a flat optimum at H = 4 or H = 8 across scales. We adopt H = 8 for large-scale models; over-splitting beyond this point (H = 16) consistently gives back part of the gain. A direct probe of the trained queries confirms that learned subspace disagreement is the underlying driver. Fused Triton routing kernels increase attention-residual training throughput from 0.2-0.5x to 0.55-0.88x of the baseline while maintaining near-baseline peak memory. An identity-preserving conversion using delta attention residuals supports 8B mid-training, yielding improvements of +3.2 on GSM8K and +3.1 on GPQA.

</details>


### [300] [KernelGenBench: A Multi-Source and Multi-Chip Benchmark for LLM-based Kernel Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27231)
*Peiyu Zang,Jian Tao,Jialing Zhang,Yichen Yuan,Wentao Zhang,Guang Liu,Yonghua Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出KernelGenBench，一个统一的基准测试框架，用于系统评估LLM和智能体生成的Triton内核，覆盖多算子来源（210个算子，三种来源）和多硬件平台（110个算子子集，六种异构平台）。大规模评估（150亿token）揭示：基于智能体的方法优于纯LLM采样，但跨平台性能严重退化（如AutoKernel从NVIDIA的87%降至平台E的25%），且自主内核生成成本极高（专用智能体方法平均每个成功算子消耗511万token）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM增加了对高效加速器内核的需求，但内核开发仍是高度专业化和劳动密集型的任务。尽管LLM和智能体框架为自动内核生成提供了新途径，但目前缺乏一个全面的基准来严格评估LLM生成的内核在不同算子来源和异构硬件平台上的性能，因此需要统一基准来填补这一空白。

Method: 构建KernelGenBench统一基准，包含两个互补子基准：(1) KernelGenBench-MS（多源），评估来自三种不同于标准PyTorch中心任务的210个算子；(2) KernelGenBench-MC（多芯片），使用110个算子子集在六种异构硬件平台上测量性能可移植性。采用大规模评估方案，消费超过150亿token。

Result: 三大发现：(1) 基于智能体的方法一致优于纯LLM采样方法，cuBLAS算子对所有方法最具挑战性；(2) 生成性能在不同硬件平台上差异显著，即使是最近的内核专用智能体也经历严重的跨平台退化（AutoKernel从NVIDIA的87%降至平台E的25%）；(3) 自主内核生成成本极高，专用智能体方法平均每个成功算子需511万token（AKO4all达519万），比简单LLM采样高出数个数量级。

Conclusion: KernelGenBench为LLM和智能体生成内核提供了首个全面的跨源、跨平台评估基准，揭示了当前方法在算子多样性、硬件可移植性和成本效率方面的关键瓶颈，为未来自动内核生成研究指明了方向。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have significantly increased the demand for efficient accelerator kernels, but kernel development remains a highly specialized and labor-intensive task. The recent rise of LLMs and agentic frameworks offers a promising pathway toward automatic kernel generation. However, despite rapid progress, there is still no comprehensive benchmark to rigorously evaluate LLM-generated kernels across diverse operator sources or heterogeneous hardware platforms. We present KernelGenBench, a unified benchmark for systematically evaluating LLM- and agent-generated Triton kernels across diverse operator sources and heterogeneous hardware platforms. It comprises two complementary sub-benchmarks: KernelGenBench-MS (Multi-Source), evaluating 210 operators from three sources beyond standard PyTorch-centric tasks, and KernelGenBench-MC (Multi-Chip), measuring performance portability across six heterogeneous hardware platforms using a 110-operator subset. Our large-scale evaluation, consuming over 15 billion tokens, shows: (1) agent-based methods consistently outperform pure LLM sampling methods, while cuBLAS operators are the most challenging across all methods; (2) generation performance varies significantly across hardware platforms, with even recent kernel-specialized agents experiencing severe cross-platform degradation (e.g., AutoKernel drops from 87% on NVIDIA to 25% on Platform E); (3) autonomous kernel generation remains highly cost-intensive, with specialized agent methods averaging 5.11 million tokens per successful operator (AKO4all reaches 5.19 million), orders of magnitude higher than simple LLM sampling approaches.

</details>


### [301] [RadHarmony: Radiological Data Handling in the Era of Agentic AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27235)
*Frank Li,Bardia Khosravi,Mohammadreza Chavoshi,Theo Dapamede,YoungSeok Jeon,Janice Newsome,Hari Trivedi,Judy Gichoya*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RadHarmony是一个开源Python库，为放射学图像数据集提供统一的加载、协调（harmonization）和增强API，支持胸部X光、CT和MRI，标准化24个公开数据集，并集成AI代理辅助新数据集整合流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在放射学图像上训练深度学习模型需要整合来自不同来源、文件格式、目录布局、标签模式和注释类型的异构数据集，缺乏统一的工具来简化这一过程。

Method: RadHarmony提供统一API，将24个公共数据集的元数据标准化为单一表格格式；封装MONAI的map-style数据集以提供深度学习就绪的样本交付并支持磁盘缓存；通过单一接口支持分类标签、分割掩码、边界框和放射学报告文本；提供交互式可视化工具；引入AI-agent技能引导从原始数据检查到代码生成和测试的完整数据集整合工作流。

Result: 通过预训练RadHarmony-ViT（一种参考视觉Transformer基线）证明了库的实用性，该模型仅用无数据集特定代码即可组合三个异构胸部X光数据集。

Conclusion: RadHarmony降低了异构放射学数据集整合门槛，使研究者无需为每个数据集编写定制代码即可训练深度学习模型，代码和预训练权重已开源。

Abstract: Training deep learning models on radiological images requires integrating heterogeneous datasets across different sources, file formats, directory layouts, label schemas, and annotation types. We present RadHarmony, an open-source Python library that provides a unified API for loading, harmonizing, and augmenting radiological datasets, with a primary focus on chest radiographs and early support for computed tomography (CT) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). RadHarmony standardizes metadata from 24 public datasets into a single tabular format, wraps MONAI's map-style datasets for deep-learning-ready sample delivery with optional on-disk caching, and supports classification labels, segmentation masks, bounding boxes, and radiology report text through a single interface, with an interactive visualization tool for dataset exploration and verification. To lower the barrier for integrating new datasets, RadHarmony introduces an AI-agent skill that guides the full integration workflow from raw data inspection through code generation and testing. We demonstrate the library's utility by pretraining RadHarmony-ViT, a reference vision transformer baseline that combines three heterogeneous chest radiograph datasets with no dataset-specific code. The code and pretrained model weights are available at https://github.com/f10409/RadHarmony.

</details>


### [302] [Asymmetric Collapse in Model Merging: When Refusal Over- writes Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27240)
*Aarnav Choudhary,Matheus Fonseca Rocha,Jiwon Seo,Vasu Sharma,Maheep Chaudhary*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过受控案例研究发现，标准模型合并方法（Linear、SLERP、TIES、DARE-TIES）在合并两个互补的安全目标微调模型时，攻击抵抗能力（拒绝率81-85%）远优于分类精度（最高12.9%），揭示了安全相关任务向量在尺度上的差异会导致合并模型退化为广泛拒绝行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型合并通常用于在没有额外训练的情况下组合独立微调模型的能力，但现有方法能否同时保留多个与安全相关的行为尚不清楚。作者希望探索标准合并方法在整合不同安全目标时是否会导致安全功能退化。

Method: 使用两个Gemma-3-1B-IT微调模型分别在CARES危害级别分类和WildJailbreak对抗性拒绝两个互补安全目标上进行微调，然后使用四种合并方法（Linear、SLERP、TIES、DARE-TIES）合并模型，评估合并后模型在分类准确率、攻击抵抗力和良性顺应性上的表现，并通过权重空间测量分析任务向量的方向和大小。

Result: 四种合并方法下攻击抵抗转移显著优于分类精度：合并模型保持81-85%的越狱拒绝率，而CARES准确率最高仅12.9%。任务向量余弦相似度仅0.011（近乎正交），但拒绝微调产生的每层任务向量幅度一致性地更大，导致对幅度敏感的合并方法偏向拒绝更新。

Conclusion: 标准模型合并方法可能将安全识别折叠为广泛拒绝行为，当安全相关任务向量在尺度上差异显著时尤甚。这一发现表明需要开发新的合并策略来处理安全任务向量之间的尺度不平衡。

Abstract: Model merging is often used to combine capabilities from separately fine-tuned models without additional training, but it is unclear whether standard merging methods preserve multiple safety-relevant behaviors simultaneously. We study this question through a controlled case study using two Gemma-3-1B-IT finetunes on two complementary safety objectives: CARES harm-level classification and WildJailbreak adversarial refusal. We merge the two fine-tunes using Linear, SLERP, TIES, and DARE-TIES, and evaluate the merged models on classification accuracy, attack resistance, and benign compliance. Across all four methods, attack resistance transfers significantly more than classification accuracy: merged models retain 81-85% jailbreak refusal rates while CARES accuracy falls to at most 12.9%. Weight-space measurements suggest that this asymmetry is not caused by strongly opposing task-vector directions: the two task vectors are nearly orthogonal (cosine similarity 0.011). Instead, the refusal fine-tune induces consistently larger per-layer task-vector magnitudes, causing magnitude-sensitive methods to favor refusal updates. These results show that standard model merging can collapse safety recognition into broad refusal when safety-relevant task vectors differ substantially in scale.

</details>


### [303] [Divergence Decoding: Training-Free Capability Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27248)
*Yimi Wang,Hao Li,Shuo Yang,He Cao,Dechen Zhang,Ziang Wu,Zhiyuan Yan,Fanyang Mo,Li Yuan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Divergence Decoding，一种无需训练的能力融合框架，通过Jensen-Shannon散度监控通用模型与领域专家模型在每token上的分布分歧，当专家出现显著分歧时动态将控制权路由回通用模型，从而在保留领域知识的同时注入通用推理能力，在GPQA、ChemBench等科学基准上超越单一模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型（通用模型）擅长推理但缺乏特定科学领域的专业知识；而领域专精模型具备知识但存在推理能力下降和鲁棒性降低等专精副作用。如何在保留领域专长的同时恢复通用推理能力，是当前面临的核心困境。

Method: 借鉴投机解码中"草稿-验证"的骨架，重构为自适应路由机制。核心是利用Jensen-Shannon散度在每token处监控通用模型与专家模型之间的分布分歧。当专家模型表现出显著分歧时，将其识别为潜在推理风险，并即时将控制权路由回通用模型，实现推理时动态注入通用推理并保留领域专业知识，达成两种模型的推理时策略组合。

Result: 在Qwen和Llama系列模型上，基于GPQA、ChemBench和ChemCoTBench等科学基准的评估表明，Divergence Decoding在性能上同时超越了领域专精模型和通用模型，并有效超过了大多数单一模型基线的表现。

Conclusion: Divergence Decoding提供了一种通用、无需训练的范式，通过自适应推理时协作来融合不同LLM的能力，为在领域知识与通用推理之间取得平衡提供了一条有效路径。

Abstract: While large language models excel in reasoning, these generalists often lack knowledge for specialized scientific domains. Conversely, domain models~(specialists), while knowledgeable, suffer from specialization side-effects including diminished logic and reduced robustness.To address this dilemma, we introduce Divergence Decoding, a training-free framework for capability fusion. It reconstructs the "draft-and-verify" skeleton of speculative decoding into an adaptive routing mechanism. The core is using Jensen-Shannon divergence to monitor the distributional disagreement between the two models at each token. When the specialist exhibits significant divergence, our method identifies it as a potential reasoning risk and instantaneously routes control to the generalist. This allows the dynamic injection of general reasoning while preserving domain expertise, achieving inference-time policy composition of the generalist and the specialist.We evaluate Divergence Decoding across diverse model families (Qwen and Llama series) on challenging scientific benchmarks (GPQA, ChemBench, and ChemCoTBench). Experimental results demonstrate that Divergence Decoding outperforms both the domain-specialized and general-purpose models, effectively surpassing the performance of most single-model baseline. This suggests that Divergence Decoding provides a general, training-free paradigm for fusing diverse LLM capabilities through adaptive inference-time collaboration.

</details>


### [304] [PIE-APT: A Unified Framework for Temporal Planning and Contradiction Hunting via Incremental Direct-Derivation Abduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27287)
*Amir Hossein Sharafi,Alireza Shahbazi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个统一框架，包含PIE-Abducer（增量直接推导溯因）和PIE-APT（时间知识图谱上的溯因规划）两个模块，原生运行于高表达力描述逻辑上，通过非单调更新建模线性时间线上的状态转移，绕过最小碰集（MHS）枚举，采用反证直接推导提取缺失前提进行溯因，并结合前向链时间投影验证，在四个OWL基准上优于经典规划器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态知识图谱上的推理与规划在开放世界且信息不完整的环境中面临重大挑战：现有动作形式化常遭遇可判定性问题与Ramification Problem；而通过结构溯因管理不完备知识需要扩展的组合搜索，计算代价高昂。本文旨在统一解决可判定性、不完备知识处理与组合爆炸问题。

Method: 提出双模块统一框架：(1) PIE-Abducer采用增量直接推导溯因，将目标目标的逻辑否定注入一致分支，通过直接反驳后果提取缺失前提，避免最小碰集（MHS）枚举的组合语法搜索；(2) PIE-APT采用递归生成-测试架构，交错进行反向链A*搜索与PIE-Abducer直至有界因果深度，再通过前向链时间投影进行严格验证。状态转移沿线性时间线建模为对演绎闭合的DL理论进行非单调更新，增量推理器作为黑盒，动作原生表示于OWL中，保证了逻辑可判定性。

Result: 在四个强调经典规划所不具备的语义能力的OWL基准上进行评估：参数化目标与见证搜索、搜索中DL蕴含、开放世界假设注入以及对抗性矛盾搜寻。结果表明该方法在定性上优于经典规划器，且直接推导方法在溯因增强过程中定量上优于基于MHS的基线方法。

Conclusion: 该工作证明通过直接推导的溯因方式可以有效替代最小碰集枚举，在保持逻辑可判定性的同时提升不完备知识下动态知识图谱规划的质量与效率，为开放世界环境中的溯因规划提供了新的范式。

Abstract: Reasoning and planning over Dynamic Knowledge Graphs (DKGs) present significant challenges, especially in open-world environments with incomplete information. Existing action formalisms often face decidability issues and the Ramification Problem, while managing incomplete knowledge via structural abduction requires expansive combinatorial search. This paper introduces a unified framework with two integrated modules---\textbf{PIE-Abducer} (incremental direct-derivation abduction) and \textbf{PIE-APT} (Abductive Planning for Temporal KGs)---operating natively on the highly expressive Description Logic. We model state transitions along a linear timeline as non-monotonic updates to deductively closed DL theories. Treating the incremental reasoner as a black-box and representing actions natively in OWL without external modal operators preserves logical decidability. To address incomplete knowledge, \textbf{PIE-Abducer} circumvents traditional Minimal Hitting Set (MHS) enumeration. Instead of combinatorial syntactic search, it injects the logical negation of a target goal into a consistent branch and extracts missing premises via direct refutation consequences. \textbf{PIE-APT} then employs a recursive \textit{Generate-and-Test} architecture, interleaving backward-chaining A* search with \textbf{PIE-Abducer} up to a bounded causal depth, followed by strict validation via forward-chaining Temporal Projection. We evaluate four OWL benchmarks stressing semantic abilities absent in classical planning: parameterized goals with witness search, mid-search DL entailment, open-world assumption injection, and adversarial contradiction hunting. Results demonstrate qualitative superiority over classical planners and prove our direct-derivation approach quantitatively outperforms an MHS-faithful baseline during abductive enrichment.

</details>
