Results show systematic preference patterns rather than random behavior, with a consistent ordering: $ \text{Formal} \approx \text{Naturalized Formal} > \text{Pure Natural Language} > \text{Input--Output Examples} $. Example effects further depend on model capability and function family.
  We extend the framework to heterogeneous specification conflicts in Boolean algebra, code generation, and the clinical domain, demonstrating its applicability across diverse tasks and specification forms. The framework provides a unified approach for measuring how LLMs resolve conflicts between competing sources of information.

</details>


### [405] [QuantWAMs: Calibrating at the Right Granularity for World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28405)
*Jiacheng Zhou,Jinfan Lv,Ruixuan Li,Longtai Zhang,Yan Wang,Wenqiang Zhang,Lizhe Qi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: QuantWAMs是一个针对世界动作模型（WAMs）的后训练量化框架，通过共享基座异常值校准、共训练目标显著性分析和固定干预回滚审计三种策略，在W4A4主导配置下实现了与FP16仅差0.2-0.7个百分点（仿真均值）的性能，将峰值权重与激活内存降低至FP16的约29%，并提供1.4-1.6倍的块级加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通过联合预测未来观测和动作来工作，但其迭代去噪和闭环执行导致部署成本高昂。现有的后训练量化（PTQ）方法不适合WAMs，因为它们依赖开环目标、同质模型假设以及与实际部署不符的校准分布。需要一个将量化决策与模型结构、回滚分布和任务目标相一致的PTQ框架。

Method: QuantWAMs提出了三种核心策略：(1) 共享基座异常值校准——仅在坐标兼容的模块间汇聚激活证据进行异常值校准；(2) 共训练目标显著性——从联合视频-动作梯度计算经验Fisher分数，并在校准稳定的层粒度上分配权重精度；(3) 固定干预回滚审计——通过可达的闭环状态修正去噪步骤保护调度，且不改变精度预算。

Result: 在Fast-WAM和LingBot-VA上，跨RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO及AgiBot G2真实机器人操作进行评估。W4A4主导设置下，仿真均值与FP16差异为0.2-0.7个百分点。真实机器人试验在三个操作任务上验证了部署可行性。针对视频和动作块，峰值权重与激活内存降至FP16的约29%，提供1.4-1.6倍的块级加速。

Conclusion: QuantWAMs证明了通过将量化决策与部署上下文（模型结构、回滚分布和任务目标）对齐，可以显著提升WAMs的后训练量化效果，在保持任务性能的同时实现大幅内存节省和推理加速，为世界动作模型的高效部署提供了一条可行路径。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly predict future observations and actions, but their iterative denoising and closed-loop execution make efficient deployment costly. Existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods are poorly suited to WAMs because they rely on open-loop objectives, homogeneous model assumptions, and calibration distributions that do not reflect deployment. We present QuantWAMs, a PTQ framework that aligns quantization decisions with the calibration context defined by model structure, rollout distribution, and task objective. QuantWAMs introduces three strategies: shared-basis outlier calibration, which pools activation evidence only across coordinate-compatible modules; co-training-objective saliency, which computes empirical-Fisher scores from the joint video--action gradient and assigns weight precision at a calibration-stable layer granularity; and fixed-intervention rollout auditing, which revises denoising-step protection schedules using reachable closed-loop states without changing the precision budget. We evaluate QuantWAMs on Fast-WAM and LingBot-VA across RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO, and real-robot manipulation with an AgiBot G2. Under a W4A4-dominant setting, the reported simulation means differ from FP16 by 0.2--0.7 percentage points. Real-robot trials further establish deployment feasibility on three manipulation tasks. For the targeted video and action blocks, QuantWAMs reduces peak weight-and-activation memory to about 29\% of FP16 and provides 1.4--1.6$\times$ block-level speedups.

</details>


### [406] [When Derived Measurements Mislead: Quantifying and Mitigating LLM Over-Trust with Privileged-Modality Reliability Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28421)
*Zongheng Guo,Tao Chen,Tianli Li,Mingzhe Cui,Yang Jiao,Lei Xie,Yi Pan,Xiao Hu,Manuela Ferrario*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文定义了"衍生特征过度信任"(DFOT)问题——下游大语言模型将实例依赖有效的衍生测量值当作直接事实或超出其有效范围使用。以生理信号感知为例，通过两个测试(D1/D2)和五个量化指标评估该问题，并在50,000对PPG-ECG记录上验证了基线方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 衍生测量值在现代LLM管线中被频繁当作直接事实使用，但其有效性是实例依赖的。这种过度信任可能导致下游判断错误，现有研究缺乏对这一系统性失败的明确定义和统一评估框架。

Method: 以生理感知为案例：D1测试LLM接受被离线ECG反驳的PPG衍生心律；D2测试在误导性严重病史下拒绝离线确认的可靠PPG心律。ECG仅用于训练监督和离线参考构建，不暴露给LLM。提出五个估计量：COTR、CIR、CRR、ESRM和UHR。采用ECG-to-PPG特权蒸馏作为基线基线，并与PPG-only推理对比。

Result: 在协议锁定的187名患者测试集上，基线方法在四个修复和特异性端点提升了1.82-6.69个百分点，所有配对置信区间排除零；UHR增加0.67个百分点(95% CI: -0.4至+1.7)。

Conclusion: DFOT提供了一个统一的评估目标，用于衡量和比较更强大的缓解方法对衍生测量过度信任问题的改进效果。

Abstract: Derived measurements increasingly enter large language model (LLM) pipelines as direct facts despite their instance-dependent validity. We define derived-feature over-trust (DFOT) as the failure in which a downstream LLM assigns such a measurement the epistemic status of a direct fact or uses it outside its valid scope. Using physiological sensing as a case study, D1 tests acceptance of a PPG-derived rhythm contradicted by offline ECG, whereas D2 tests rejection of an offline-confirmed reliable PPG rhythm under misleading severe history. ECG supplies training supervision and offline reference construction but is never shown to the LLM. Five estimands quantify this chain: conflict over-trust rate (COTR) and context-induced error rate (CIR) characterize D1/D2; correct repair rate (CRR) measures frozen-error repair; evidence-specific repair margin (ESRM) contrasts matched and patient-disjoint shuffled evidence; and utility harm rate (UHR) measures unnecessary verification among HIGH-reliability cases used without verification at baseline. The framework does not depend on a particular reliability generator. We demonstrate it on 50,000 paired PPG-ECG records using ECG-to-PPG privileged distillation as an illustrative baseline and PPG-only inference. On a protocol-locked 187-patient test, the baseline improves four repair and specificity endpoints by 1.82-6.69 percentage points, with all paired confidence intervals excluding zero; UHR increases by 0.67 percentage points (95% CI: -0.4 to +1.7). DFOT provides a common evaluation target for stronger mitigation methods. The code is available at https://github.com/Zongheng-Guo/When-Derived-Measurements-Mislead.

</details>


### [407] [A foundation model of numerical intelligence with cross-disciplinary generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28432)
*Chenghan Wu,Zongmin Yu,Liu Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出UNICON（统一上下文算子网络），一个在数值领域展现"数值智能"的基础模型。通过从图结构示例中学习系统间的预测关系并将其应用于新查询，UNICON能在跨学科（包括训练中未见的学科）实现接近专家水平的性能，无需重新训练。结合语言模型智能体后，甚至能在未见学科上超越最先进的专家模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统上，智能被理解为从语言文本中获取和应用知识的能力，大型语言模型已展现出这一能力。然而，科学和社会系统往往涉及数值数据，需要模型能够从数值上下文（而非仅文本）中获取和应用知识。现有的语言模型无法直接处理纯数值场景，因此需要一个能够从数值上下文进行学习和推理的智能模型，即"数值智能"。

Method: UNICON采用基于图（graph-based）的示例作为上下文输入，从同一系统的多个示例中推断出共享的预测关系，并将该关系应用到同一系统的新查询中。该方法允许模型在新系统中进行上下文学习（in-context learning），实现零训练迁移。模型还可与语言模型智能体结合，形成跨模态协同系统。

Result: UNICON在多个科学和社会系统中展现接近专家水平的性能，包括训练中未见的学科。与语言模型智能体结合后，在训练中未见的学科上超越了最先进的专家模型。此外，研究还发现训练语料库的多样性能够提升对未见学科的泛化能力。

Conclusion: UNICON被确立为数值智能的基础模型，填补了语言智能之外的空白。它不仅解决了数值上下文中的知识获取和应用问题，还为更广泛的人工智能生态系统提供了基础组件，展示了上下文学习能力可以超越语言模态扩展到数值领域。

Abstract: Intelligence is commonly understood as the ability to acquire and apply knowledge, adapt to unfamiliar situations and solve new problems. Large language models exhibit this capacity by inferring task-relevant knowledge from textual context and applying it to new tasks. Yet intelligence need not be confined to language. For scientific and social systems, we need models that acquire and apply knowledge from numerical context-an ability we call numerical intelligence. Here we introduce UNified In-Context Operator Networks (UNICON), a foundation model that exhibits numerical intelligence across disciplines. Using graph-based examples from a system as context, UNICON infers the predictive relation shared across them and applies it to queries from the same system. Across scientific and social systems, including those from disciplines absent from training, the same model approaches specialist performance without retraining. Combining UNICON with language-model agents yields further gains, enabling it to surpass state-of-the-art specialists in a discipline unseen in training. We further show that training-corpus diversity improves generalization to unseen disciplines. Together, these results establish UNICON as a foundation model of numerical intelligence and position it as a building block for a broader ecosystem of artificial intelligence.

</details>


### [408] [LeanCSP: A Framework for Certifying Constraint Reformulation and Solving in Lean](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28459)
*Pablo Manrique,Stefan Szeider*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个在Lean定理证明器中构建的约束编程验证框架，同时覆盖问题形式化层面的语义保持性验证（如等价性、等满足性和对称性破坏约束的正确性）和实例层面的求解器证书验证，通过翻译后端（MiniZinc、SMT-LIB、OPB）实现端到端可信推理。实验表明对称性破坏的验证可将求解搜索开销减少高达2×10^7倍，且认证代价仅需数分钟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 约束编程是求解调度、规划、配置和验证等复杂组合问题的核心技术，但其结果的可信性需要双重保证：一是预处理/重构必须是语义保持的，二是求解器必须产生正确的结果。现有方法通常只解决其中一层，缺乏统一的形式化框架。

Method: 在Lean定理证明器中构建统一框架：支持以参数化方式对整类问题族证明形式化层面的性质（等价性、等满足性、对称性破坏正确性）；通过翻译后端将问题转换到MiniZinc、SMT-LIB和OPB等外部格式，并检查求解器生成的证书；将两层验证结合形成端到端工作流。

Result: 实验表明，验证过的对称性破坏在实际求解中效果显著：每个问题族只需一次参数化证明，即可在所有实例规模上复用，将求解搜索努力减少最多2×10^7倍；同时在Lean内部的认证代价可控，最大实例的认证耗时仅几分钟。

Conclusion: 该框架证明了无需信任外部求解器即可建立约束问题的可满足性或不可满足性，实现了形式化层面与实例层面的双重验证闭环，并兼顾了实用效率。

Abstract: Constraint programming is a core technology for solving complex combinatorial problems in scheduling, planning, configuration, and verification. Trusting its results therefore demands guarantees at two levels: that reformulations applied beforehand are semantics-preserving, and that solvers produce correct answers. In this work, we introduce a framework that addresses both verification levels in the Lean theorem prover: it can be used to prove formulation-level properties, such as equivalence, equisatisfiability, and the correctness of symmetry-breaking constraints, parametrically for entire problem families; and to check solver-produced certificates for individual instances via translation backends to external formats such as MiniZinc, SMT-LIB, and OPB. Combining both levels yields an end-to-end workflow that establishes the satisfiability or unsatisfiability of a constraint problem without trusting the external solver. Experimental results show that our framework's verified symmetry breaking also pays off in practice: a single parametric proof per problem family, reused across all instance sizes, reduces solver search effort by a factor of up to 2x10^7, while the entire in-Lean certification stays affordable, taking at most a few minutes for our largest instances.

</details>


### [409] [A report-grounded vision-language foundation model for colonoscopy from 280000 routine reports](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28466)
*Jia Yu,Yan Zhu,Yili He,Zilong Wang,Xinyang Jiang,Peiyao Fu,Ruijie Yang,Tianyi Chen,Siyuan Li,Zhihua Wang,Fei Wu,Quanlin Li,Xian Yang,Pinghong Zhou,Shuo Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出EndoCLIP，一个基于125,756对病变级别图像-文本对训练的内窥镜视觉语言基础模型，在病灶级图文检索、结构化报告生成和六个多中心临床分类任务中均优于通用和生物医学视觉语言编码器，其线性探针在良恶性分类上接近12位内镜专家的水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结肠镜检查中产生了丰富的专家文字报告，但这些报告是整体手术过程的总结，而非对单个帧的描述，导致临床发现与对应图像之间缺乏弱监督联系，视觉语言模型在结肠镜检查中的价值未被充分利用。

Method: 从280,476份常规结肠镜报告中逐步恢复出125,756对病变级图像-文本对，用于训练EndoCLIP视觉语言基础模型；通过病灶级图文检索、结构化报告生成及零样本/线性探针设置下的六项多中心临床分类任务进行验证评估。

Result: EndoCLIP在所有评估任务（病灶级图文检索、结构化报告生成和六个多中心临床分类任务）中均优于通用和生物医学视觉语言编码器；在良恶性分类中，其线性探针性能接近12位内镜专家在盲法研究中的表现。

Conclusion: 恢复发现与帧之间的对应关系可以将常规文档转化为可扩展的监督信号，使临床目标能够通过语言进行指定，而无需为每个任务单独进行标注，从而推动临床任务更灵活、高效地部署。

Abstract: Vision-language models remain underused in colonoscopy despite the rich expert descriptions recorded in routine reports. These reports document lesion appearance, size and location but summarise entire procedures rather than caption individual frames, leaving clinical findings only weakly linked to the corresponding images. Here we develop EndoCLIP, a colonoscopy vision-language foundation model trained on 125,756 lesion-level image-text pairs progressively recovered from 280,476 routine colonoscopy records. Across lesion-level image-text retrieval, structured report generation and six multi-centre clinical classification tasks, EndoCLIP outperforms general-purpose and biomedical vision-language encoders in both zero-shot and linear-probe settings. On benign-versus-malignant classification, its linear probe approaches the performance of expert readers in a blinded study involving 12 endoscopists. These results suggest that recovering finding-to-frame correspondence can transform routine documentation into scalable supervision, enabling clinical targets to be specified in language rather than separately annotated for each task.

</details>


### [410] [Towards Autonomous Aircraft Surveillance from Nanosatellites through On-Board Inference and Generative Data Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28470)
*Antonio Delgado-Rosa,David Muñoz-Valero,Enrique Adrian Villarrubia-Martin,Juan Moreno-Garcia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合星上推理与生成式数据增强的工作流，在6U立方星上通过边缘张量加速器执行检测，同时利用低秩适配微调的扩散模型生成合成少数类飞机影像进行数据增强，从而同时解决纳米卫星下行链路带宽受限和开放航空数据集类不平衡的两大瓶颈。实验表明，均衡数据集将全局mAP从77.9%提升至82.2%，少数类F1从0.683提升至0.811，量化检测器适配星上内存并可实现在轨25-30帧/秒的处理速度，为纳米卫星实时自主空中监视提供了决策支持工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低地球轨道空基监视面临两大相互关联的瓶颈：一是纳米卫星下行链路预算有限，而传统方法仍将TB级原始影像传输至地面处理，导致决策延迟；二是开放航空卫星数据集稀少且类别严重不平衡，使得标准检测器难以学习稀有飞机类别的鲁棒表示。作者旨在联合解决这两个问题，实现实时自主的空中监视。

Method: 提出一个将星上推理与生成式数据增强相结合的工作流：(1) 在配备低功耗边缘张量加速器的6U CubeSat上执行推理；(2) 通过低秩适配(LoRA)微调的扩散模型生成合成少数类飞机影像；(3) 合成输出由中间检测器自动标注（伪标签）；(4) 将合成样本与传统增强样本合并形成均衡数据集用于训练检测器。

Result: 均衡数据集使全局平均精度(mAP)从77.9%提升至82.2%；少数类F1分数从0.683提升至0.811；量化后的检测器适配星上芯片内存限制，可实现在轨25-30帧/秒的投影处理速度。

Conclusion: 计算测试支持该工作流作为纳米卫星实时自主空中监视的决策支持工具。该方案与传统"弯管"(bent-pipe)架构形成鲜明对比——传统架构中卫星仅作为被动数据收集器，而本方案使卫星具备自主在轨计算与决策能力。

Abstract: Airborne surveillance from low Earth orbit is hindered by two interconnected bottlenecks: nanosatellites have a limited downlink budget, yet the conventional approach still transmits terabytes of raw imagery to the ground for processing, and open satellite datasets for aircraft are scarce and severely class-imbalanced. These limitations either delay timely decision-making or prevent standard detectors from learning robust representations of rare aircraft classes. In this paper, a workflow that combines on-board inference with generative data augmentation is proposed to address both limitations jointly. Inference is executed on a 6U CubeSat equipped with a low-power edge tensor accelerator, while a diffusion model fine-tuned through low-rank adaptation generates synthetic minority-class imagery. This synthetic output is automatically annotated, pseudo-labelled, by an intermediate detector and merged with classically augmented samples. The results show that the balanced dataset increases global mean average precision from 77.9% to 82.2%, with the minority class rising from F1=0.683 to F1=0.811, and that the quantised detector fits the on-chip memory and projects 25-30 frames per second on orbit. This approach contrasts with the conventional bent-pipe architecture, in which the satellite acts as a passive data collector. Therefore, the computational tests support the proposed workflow as a decision-support tool for real-time, autonomous airborne surveillance from nanosatellites.

</details>


### [411] [A Fuzzy Rule-based Neuro-Symbolic Approach for Pipe Severity Prediction in Sewer Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28481)
*Ngoc Thai Le,Thanh Ma,Umberto Straccia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究提出一个模块化的模糊规则神经符号框架，将Swin Transformer神经感知与基于决策树提取的模糊IF-THEN规则推理解耦，用于自动下水道管道严重程度评估，相比纯图像分类在四个指标上分别提升17.9%、12.2%、23.0%和17.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统自动下水道管道严重程度评估依赖直接的图像分类，形成"黑箱"模型，视觉缺陷与最终严重度评分之间的关联是隐式的，缺乏可解释性和可追溯的推理链路。

Method: 框架分为两个模块：(1)神经感知模块使用Swin Transformer从图像直接预测14个多标签检查CODE等级；(2)符号推理模块使用Weka J48决策树在真实CODE和严重度标签上训练，将树路径转换为19条固定IF-THEN规则；推理时通过模糊逻辑（t-norm激活CODE条件，按规则置信度加权，结合s-norm）产生可解释的类别证据。评估了Product、Łukasiewicz和Hamacher算子对，使用3,244张图像覆盖五个高度不平衡的严重度类别，并通过五个独立大语言模型对原始检查员注释的一致分析生成稳健的真实标签。

Result: 相比纯图像分类，准确率、平衡准确率、Macro F1和MCC分别提升了17.9%、12.2%、23.0%和17.3%。框架在类别平衡性能上具有竞争力，同时实现了从预测CODE等级到规则支持再到严重度证据的可追溯推理。

Conclusion: 该神经符号框架成功弥合了神经感知与符号推理之间的鸿沟，在保持类别平衡性能的同时提供了完全可解释、可追溯的推理链条，为下水道管道严重程度评估提供了一种兼具准确性和透明度的解决方案。

Abstract: Standard automated sewer pipe severity assessment relies on direct image classification, creating a "black box" where the link between visual defects and final severity scores remains implicit. This study introduces a modular, fuzzy rule-based neuro-symbolic framework that bridges this gap by decoupling neural perception from symbolic reasoning. The perception module utilizes a Swin Transformer to predict 14 multilabel inspection CODE degrees directly from images. For reasoning, a DT, specifically Weka's J48, algorithm is trained on ground-truth CODEs and severity labels, and its paths are converted into 19 fixed IF--THEN rules. Inference operates via fuzzy logic: t-norm activations from CODE conditions are weighted by rule confidence and combined with corresponding s-norms to produce interpretable class evidence. We assessed Product, Łukasiewicz, and Hamacher operator pairs using a dataset of 3,244 images spanning five highly imbalanced severity classes. Ground-truth labels were robustly generated via consensus from five independent large language models analyzing original inspector notes. Our results show an improvement of accuracy, balanced accuracy, Macro F1 and MCC by 17.9%, 12.2%, 23.0%, and 17.3%, respectively, over image-only based classification.
  Overall, the framework combines competitive class-balanced performance with traceable reasoning from predicted CODE degrees to rule supports and severity evidence.

</details>


### [412] [SCOPE: Supply-Chain Operations through Coupled Policies for End-to-End Coordination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28488)
*Yunhao Liang,Xianqi Cao,Pujun Zhang,Yuan Qu,Yongzhi Qi,Ningxuan Kang,Max Z. J. Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SCOPE框架，将供应链运营中的多项耦合决策（选品、货源分配、补货频率、路径规划）统一为复合策略模型，通过将供应链实体表示为token并在共享操作表征下进行端到端联合优化，在叮咚买菜和京东的真实数据上验证了优于分阶段独立优化方法的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代供应链中选品、货源分配、补货频率和配送路径等决策在操作上高度耦合，但通常由不同部门通过独立系统分别优化，导致缺货、库存积压和运输浪费。现有方法缺乏对跨部门运营耦合的端到端协调视角。

Method: 提出SCOPE（Supply-Chain Operations through Coupled Policies for End-to-End Coordination）复合策略模型：将供应链实体表示为token，通过共享操作表征进行上下文学习，将每种token类型映射到对应决策接口；每个决策基于先前决策形成的部分计划，最终完整计划用共享的系统级效用函数评估。

Result: 在叮咚买菜和京东两个不同补货层级的大型供应链真实运营数据上，SCOPE在两个场景中均一致优于分阶段独立优化的方法以及行业常用基线。

Conclusion: 学习并协调跨部门运营耦合能够带来更有效的端到端供应链决策，表明统一操作规划优于隔离的决策模块。

Abstract: Can supply-chain AI move beyond isolated decision modules toward unified operational planning? A complete replenishment plan specifies which products each location carries, which upstream facility supplies it, how often it is replenished, and how deliveries are routed. These decisions are operationally coupled: the selected assortment changes the demand and load passed to later stages; source assignment and replenishment frequency reshape the delivery requests; and route feasibility and cost, in turn, determine the system value of the earlier choices. Yet in modern supply chains, these decisions are often handled by separate departments and optimized through separate systems, which can lead to stockouts, inventory exposure, and avoidable transportation. We propose SCOPE: Supply-Chain Operations through Coupled Policies for End-to-End Coordination, a composite policy model that represents supply-chain entities as tokens, contextualizes them through a shared operational representation, and maps each token type to the corresponding decision interface. Each decision builds on the partial plan formed by earlier decisions while the completed plan is evaluated using a shared system-level utility. We instantiate this framework in urban fresh-retail replenishment, where service frequency, assortment, capacity pressure, and road-network routing interact strongly, and evaluate it on real operational data from Dingdong and JD.com, two large-scale supply chains operating at different replenishment echelons. Across both settings, SCOPE consistently outperforms methods that optimize each decision stage separately, as well as practice-oriented baselines commonly used in supply-chain operations. These results show that learning and coordinating cross-department operational couplings lead to more effective end-to-end supply-chain decisions.

</details>


### [413] [InfoOps Bench: A live information operations safety benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28503)
*Dorian Quelle,Lisa-Maria Neudert,Jonathan Bright,John Gallacher*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个持续更新的AI基准测试（InfoOpsBench），用于测量前沿语言模型被用于国家支持的信息操作的完整性。基于对2,100多个信息操作的实时监控，测试了8个提供商的17个模型在四种提示框架下的表现，发现大多数模型可被用于信息操作，完整性得分从8.8%到94.5%不等，且模型选择会改变信息操作的特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿语言模型可能被国家支持的信息行动所利用或"收编"，现有基准测试多为静态、容易过饱和。需要一个动态、持续更新的基准来实时评估模型的完整性，防止模型被用于信息操纵。

Method: 从实时监控管道中提取2,100多个俄罗斯、中国和伊朗国家支持的信息操作，构建动态基准。对17个模型（来自8个提供商）在四种提示框架下进行测试，以拒绝率（完整性得分）和输出特征（事实核查率、内容变化等）作为评估指标，并发布每周更新的配套网站。

Result: 大多数模型可被用于信息操作。完整性得分范围8.8%-94.5%，差距达85.7个百分点且与模型规模无关。模型选择改变操作特征：有的模型编造细节且输出比源材料更有害，有的在合规时化解主张，事实核查率从2.9%到72.9%不等。中国开发的模型在涉及中国批评但事实有据的主张上合规率骤降48-70个百分点。

Conclusion: 模型对抗信息操作的完整性部分与对良性主张的拒绝倾向相关，说明在模型可用性与安全性之间存在权衡。中国模型对涉华批评内容的"回避"揭示了地缘政治因素对模型行为的影响，动态基准的持续更新使其不易饱和，为评估和改进前沿模型抵御信息操纵的能力提供了重要工具。

Abstract: In this paper we present an active, constantly updated AI benchmark which measures the integrity of frontier language models against being co-opted for state-backed information operations. We draw on over 2,100 information operations from a live monitoring pipeline which tracks Russian, Chinese and Iranian state-backed information assets. Alongside this paper, we release a companion website that tracks the most prominent claims spread by state-backed media outlets, updated weekly, available from: pattrn.ai/research/infoopsbench. The dynamic nature of the benchmark makes it resistant to saturation.
  In the benchmark, we test 17 models from 8 providers across four prompt framings. We find that most models can be co-opted for information operations. Integrity scores, defined as the percentage of refused requests, range from 8.8% to 94.5%, an 85.7-percentage-point spread not explained by model size. Model choice also changes the character of the resulting operation. Some models fabricate details and produce output more harmful than the source material, others defuse claims even while complying, and fact-checking rates vary from 2.9% to 72.9%.
  Integrity against information operations is at least partly related to refusal to produce content even for benign claims, illustrating the challenge of balancing model usability with safety. With one exception (Z.ai's GLM 5.2), the Chinese-developed models sharply cut compliance on factually grounded but China-critical claims, dropping 48-70 percentage points relative to matched benign claims.

</details>


### [414] [Selective Credibility-Limited Belief Update](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28523)
*Theofanis Aravanis,Costas D. Koutras*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出选择性可信度受限信念更新（selective credibility-limited belief update），将复合认知输入按源世界转化为更弱的代理后再执行可信度受限转移，从而能够表示仅部分认知输入可实现的情形。文章给出了语义与公理刻画，识别了两类良性子类（一致性保持与最大一致性保持算子），并证明该框架统一并扩展了标准Katsuno-Mendelzon更新与可信度受限信念更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可信度受限信念更新方法将认知输入视为不可分割的整体，无法表示复合认知输入中仅部分可实现的情形。标准Katsuno-Mendelzon更新假设认知输入可从每个初始可能世界被完全纳入，过于理想化；而可信度受限更新虽限制了后继世界的可信度，却未对认知输入本身进行选择性处理。因此需要一种框架，能够针对不同源世界对认知输入进行选择性的弱化处理。

Method: 提出选择性可信度受限信念更新框架：相对于每个源世界，将认知输入通过转换函数转化为更弱的代理，再进行可信度受限转移。具体而言：（1）对每个源世界，认知输入被变换为更弱（可推导出原输入弱化版）的代理输入；（2）然后基于可信度受限关系执行转移。文章提供语义刻画（基于选择性可信度受限转移关系）与公理刻画（Katsuno-Mendelzon更新的推广公理集）。进一步识别两个子类：一致性保持更新算子（要求原认知输入一致时，其代理必须从源世界可信）和最大一致性保持更新算子（要求代理在原认知输入的可信后果中信息量最大）。最后通过特殊化证明框架的一般性。

Result: （1）给出了选择性可信度受限信念更新算子的语义与公理完全性刻画；（2）识别出两个良性子类：一致性保持与最大一致性保持更新算子，后者在信息量上达到最优；（3）证明了可信度受限信念更新是该框架的特例（转换函数为某种恒等变换时），而当可信度限制被移除且转换函数为恒等时，恢复为Katsuno-Mendelzon信念更新。这表明该框架是一个统一且表达能力更强的信念更新框架。

Conclusion: 该框架为信念更新提供了统一且更具表达力的理论基础，同时涵盖Katsuno-Mendelzon更新与可信度受限更新，并支持与源世界相关的选择性接受。未来工作可探讨更复杂的选择机制或与其他信念变化算子（如修正）的结合。

Abstract: Belief update concerns changes in an agent's beliefs induced by changes in the underlying world. Standard Katsuno-Mendelzon update assumes that an epistemic input can be incorporated from every initially possible world, whereas credibility-limited belief update restricts, for each source world, the successor worlds regarded as credible or reachable. Nevertheless, existing credibility-limited approaches treat the epistemic input as an indivisible whole, and therefore cannot represent cases in which only part of a compound epistemic input can be realized. We introduce selective credibility-limited belief update, in which the epistemic input is transformed, relative to each source world, into a weaker proxy before the credibility-limited transition is performed. We provide semantic and axiomatic characterizations of the resulting class of update operators. We then identify two well-behaved sub-classes; namely, consistency-preserving update operators, which require every transformed epistemic input to be credible from its source world whenever the original epistemic input is consistent, and maximal consistency-preserving update operators, which additionally require the selected proxy to be maximally informative among the credible consequences of the original epistemic input. Finally, we establish the generality of the proposed framework by showing that credibility-limited belief update is recovered as a special case, while Katsuno--Mendelzon belief update emerges when credibility restrictions are removed and the transformation functions are taken to be identities. These results demonstrate that the framework provides a unified and strictly more expressive account of belief update, encompassing established approaches while supporting source-dependent selective acceptance.

</details>


### [415] [MANTA: Multi-Agent Network Topology Adaptation for Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28527)
*Mao-xun Huang,Jerry Wang,Yi-Cheng Lai,Zhengxin Zhang,Claire Cardie,Hen-Hsen Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MANTA框架，使多智能体系统的通信拓扑能够在推理时自我演化，在五个基准上平均得分74.0，超过最强基线5.8个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多智能体系统通常将通信拓扑视为固定设计或离线优化目标，缺乏在推理时动态调整通信结构的能力，限制了复杂问题求解的适应性和效率。

Method: MANTA框架包含两个阶段：(1) 执行前，从先前的结构经验中初始化任务条件化的拓扑结构；(2) 部署期间，监控协作轨迹，在当前组织不足时应用有界结构更新，可修改智能体角色、通信链接、执行顺序、信息可见性和验证路径，同时保留任务接口和智能体预算。

Result: 在五个基准（信息检索、工具使用、规划、工作流执行和数学推理）上，MANTA平均得分74.0，超过最强基线5.8个百分点，并在PlanCraft上取得最佳结果。

Conclusion: 推理时的自我改进可以扩展到协作架构本身，通信结构的动态自演化能够有效提升多智能体系统的整体性能。

Abstract: Large language model-based multi-agent systems improve complex problem solving through task decomposition, agent specialization, information exchange, and intermediate validation. However, existing systems typically treat communication topology as a fixed design choice or an offline optimization target. We introduce MANTA, a framework for Multi-Agent Network Topology Adaptation that enables communication structures to self-evolve at inference time. Before execution, MANTA initializes a task-conditioned topology from prior structural experience. During deployment, it monitors collaboration traces and applies bounded structural updates when the current organization becomes insufficient. These updates can modify agent roles, communication links, execution order, information visibility, and validation pathways while preserving the task interface and agent budget. We evaluate MANTA against representative single-agent and multi-agent baselines on five benchmarks spanning information seeking, tool use, planning, workflow execution, and mathematical reasoning. MANTA achieves the highest average score of 74.0, outperforming the strongest baseline by 5.8 percentage points and obtaining the best result on PlanCraft. These results show that inference-time self-improvement can extend to the architecture of collaboration itself.

</details>


### [416] [Rethinking Inference-Time Scaling in Local Computer-Use Agents: Failure Modes and Compute Tradeoffs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28573)
*Woongkyu Lee,Jungwook Choi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了推理时扩展（inference-time scaling）在本地计算机使用智能体（CUA）中的效果，在OSWorld基准上评估了多个本地模型。发现上下文、时间、结构和并行四种维度的扩展往往收益递减并伴随失败模式转变，提出本地CUA需要选择性计算分配、失败感知控制机制和针对本地模型特性设计的智能体框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本地部署计算机使用智能体（CUA）对隐私、成本效率和实用性越来越重要，但严格硬件约束下提升其性能仍是挑战。已有研究表明推理时扩展可以提升前沿CUA的性能，但其对资源受限的本地模型是否有效仍缺乏系统理解。

Method: 在OSWorld基准上，对Qwen3-VL-8B/30B-A3B、UI-TARS-1.5-7B和OpenCUA-7B四个本地视觉语言模型，从上下文（contextual）、时间（temporal）、结构（structural）和并行（parallel）四个维度进行推理时扩展的系统实证研究。

Result: 1) 额外计算常带来收益递减且伴随失败模式转变；2) 上下文扩展提供历史基础信息，改善轨迹稳定性与任务准确率，但增益随token成本饱和，失败模式从重复/停滞转向提前假成功；3) 时间扩展减少最大步数停滞但未实质提升任务成功率，更长视野往往延长错误轨迹而非纠正；4) 结构分解在本地两阶段智能体中引入规划和格式开销；5) 并行扩展部分缓解这些失败但计算成本高昂。

Conclusion: 高效的本地CUA需要选择性计算分配、失败感知控制机制，以及围绕本地模型能力与局限设计的智能体框架，而非简单堆叠推理时计算。

Abstract: Deploying autonomous computer-use agents (CUAs) locally is increasingly important for privacy, cost efficiency, and practical usability, yet improving their performance under strict hardware constraints remains challenging. While recent studies show that inference-time scaling can improve frontier computer-use agents through additional computation during execution, its effectiveness for resource-constrained local models remains poorly understood. We present a systematic empirical study of inference-time scaling in local CUAs across contextual, temporal, structural, and parallel dimensions. We evaluate Qwen3-VL-8B/30B-A3B, UI-TARS-1.5-7B, and OpenCUA-7B on the OSWorld benchmark. Our results show that additional computation often yields diminishing returns while changing failure modes. Contextual scaling provides historical grounding that improves trajectory stability and task accuracy, but its gains saturate as token cost increases and failures shift from repetitive or stalled trajectories toward premature false successes. Temporal scaling similarly reduces max-step stalls, yet does not substantially improve task success, indicating that longer horizons often extend erroneous trajectories rather than correct them. We further find that structural decomposition can introduce planning and formatting overhead in local two-stage agents, while parallel scaling partially mitigates these failures at a substantial computational cost. Overall, our findings suggest that efficient local CUAs require selective compute allocation, failure-aware control mechanisms, and agentic frameworks designed around the capabilities and limitations of local models.

</details>


### [417] [DualG-MRAG: Decoupling Macro-Reasoning and Micro-Matching for Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28580)
*Jiacheng Tao,Qingyun Sun,Haonan Yuan,Ziwei Zhang,Jianxin Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出DualG-MRAG，一种双层级框架，通过宏推理图（全局结构路由）和微匹配图（局部细粒度验证）的分离架构，结合GNN检索器和动态规划解码机制，解决多模态RAG在多跳推理任务中粗粒度与细粒度特征之间的表征困境。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态检索增强生成（MM-RAG）在复杂多跳推理任务上表现不佳。现有方法主要依赖独立的实例级匹配，难以捕获跨模态、跨文档的显式关系；而图增强方法在多模态场景中面临两难困境：引入细粒度视觉特征会导致图快速膨胀和检索噪声，粗粒度表征则会丢失关键局部证据。

Method: 提出双层级解耦架构DualG-MRAG：(1) 构建宏图（Macro Graph）用于全局拓扑路由和微图（Micro Graph）用于精确局部验证，通过隔离全局结构推理与细粒度证据匹配来抑制检索噪声；(2) 将检索建模为查询驱动的消息传递过程，通过GNN检索器在不同异构证据源间进行动态相关性传播；(3) 设计动态规划解码机制，直接从GNN前向传播中提取显式推理路径，替代孤立文档块的拼接作为生成模型的输入，提供连贯的结构性指导。

Result: 大量实验表明DualG-MRAG在证据召回率和复杂问答准确率上均优于现有基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过宏-微双图解耦结构，DualG-MRAG成功在多模态RAG中平衡了结构建模与细粒度证据匹配之间的矛盾，为生成模型提供了可解释的显式推理路径，从而显著提升了多跳推理任务的检索与回答性能。

Abstract: While Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MM-RAG) has shown promising results, it still struggles with complex multi-hop reasoning tasks. Existing methods primarily focus on independent instance-level matching, which often fails to capture explicit relationships across modalities and documents. Although Graph-enhanced methods introduce structural modeling, they face a fundamental challenge in multimodal scenarios: incorporating fine-grained visual features leads to rapid graph expansion and retrieval noise, whereas coarse-grained representations cause the discarding of critical local evidence. To address this dilemma, we propose DualG-MRAG, a Dual-tier framework that introduces a decoupled architecture comprising Macro-reasoning and Micro-matching Graphs for Multimodal RAG. Specifically, to suppress retrieval noise by isolating global structural reasoning from fine-grained evidence matching, we construct a Macro Graph for global topological routing and a Micro Graph for precise local verification. Subsequently, to enable dynamic relevance propagation across heterogeneous evidence sources, we formulate retrieval as a query-driven message passing process via a GNN Retriever. Furthermore, to provide the generative model with coherent structural guidance, we introduce a dynamic programming decoding mechanism that extracts explicit reasoning paths directly from the GNN's forward pass, replacing the standard input of isolated document chunks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DualG-MRAG outperforms baselines in both evidence recall and complex QA accuracy.

</details>


<div id='cs.IT'></div>

# cs.IT [[Back]](#toc)

### [418] [The Capacity Region of the Broadcast Channel with Non-Signaling Assistance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27434)
*Yuhang Yao,Syed A. Jafar*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 本文完整刻画了K用户离散无记忆广播信道在非信令（NS）辅助下的容量区域，证明其与Sato区域一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 广播信道的容量区域一直是一个开放问题，非信令辅助提供了一种新的理论视角来理解广播信道的根本限制。

Method: 利用非信令辅助的数学性质，将问题转化为对消息子集上的和速率约束的分析，其中每个约束对应在给定边缘信道条件下最坏情况联合信道分布下的接收机完全协作场景。

Result: NS辅助容量区域与Sato区域完全重合，即由所有消息子集上的和速率界定义的区域，每个界对应于在最坏情况联合信道律下该子集接收机完全协作的情形。

Conclusion: 对于K用户离散无记忆广播信道，非信令辅助下的容量区域被完整刻画，且与Sato区域等价，这为非信令资源在广播信道理论中的作用提供了根本性理解。

Abstract: The capacity region of the $K$-user discrete memoryless broadcast channel is fully characterized when non-signaling (NS) assistance is available to the transmitter and all $K$ receivers. The NS-assisted capacity region is shown to coincide with Sato's region, i.e., the region defined by sum-rate bounds over all subsets of messages, where each bound corresponds to full cooperation among that subset of receivers under a worst-case joint channel law consistent with the marginal channels.

</details>


### [419] [Green Cell-Free Massive MIMO for ISAC: Joint Cloud, Fronthaul and Radio Resource Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27778)
*Zinat Behdad,Özlem Tuğfe Demir,Ki Won Sung,Pei Xiao,Cicek Cavdar*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向绿色无小区大规模MIMO（CF-mMIMO）通感一体化（ISAC）系统的跨层端到端（E2E）优化框架，在分布式多目标检测场景下，通过联合优化发射功率分配、接入点（AP）工作模式、通信用户与感知关联、接收接入点（RX-AP）分配以及云/前传资源，最小化系统总功耗，相比仅优化发射功率的方案可节省50%以上功耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CF-mMIMO与ISAC结合是6G网络的重要架构，但引入感知功能会在无线、前传和云域增加功耗，而传统仅优化发射功率的方法无法捕获这些额外能耗。因此需要一种能够全面考虑各域功耗的跨层优化框架。

Method: 提出分布式感知方案，RX-AP计算局部检验统计量并通过加权组合策略转发至云端聚合；在完全知情（FIS）和部分知情（PIS）场景下推导最大后验比检测器（MAPRT）；构建联合优化问题（混合整数非凸问题），通过基于逐次凸近似和罚函数松弛的两阶段迭代算法求解。

Result: 数值结果表明，所提出的E2E框架相较基准方案显著降低总功耗：相比仅发射功率优化节省超过50%，相比无线域优化节省约13-15%，同时保持有竞争力的检测性能。

Conclusion: 跨层端到端优化框架能够有效降低CF-mMIMO ISAC系统的整体功耗，在绿色通信与感知性能之间取得良好平衡，为6G网络中节能通感一体化系统的设计提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Cell-free massive MIMO (CF-mMIMO) combined with integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) is a promising architecture for future 6G networks, enabling new sensing-based applications. However, integrating sensing functionality increases power consumption across the radio, fronthaul, and cloud domains, which is not captured by conventional transmit power optimization approaches. In this paper, we develop a cross-layer end-to-end (E2E) optimization framework for green CF-mMIMO ISAC systems with distributed multi-target detection. We propose a distributed sensing approach in which receive access points (RX-APs) compute local test statistics and forward them to the cloud for aggregation via a weighted combination strategy. We derive maximum a posteriori ratio test (MAPRT) detectors under fully informed (FIS) and partially informed (PIS) scenarios, capturing different levels of side information available at the RX-APs. We formulate a joint optimization problem that minimizes total network power consumption by jointly optimizing transmit power allocation, AP operation modes, communication user and sensing associations, RX-AP assignments, and cloud/fronthaul resources, subject to communication and sensing constraints. The resulting mixed-integer non-convex problem is solved via a two-stage iterative algorithm based on successive convex approximation and penalty-based relaxation. Numerical results demonstrate that the proposed E2E framework significantly reduces total power consumption compared to benchmark schemes, achieving more than 50% savings over transmit-power-only optimization and approximately 13-15% over radio optimization, while maintaining competitive detection performance.

</details>


### [420] [Constructing linear codes from digraphs and groups](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28016)
*Coen del Valle,Cheryl E. Praeger*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 本文在Kaufman和Lubotzky (2012)构造的对称LDPC好码以及Kaufman-Wigderson凯莱码的基础上，提出了两种推广构造：图码（graph codes）和有向图码（digraph codes），系统研究了其代数与组合性质，并分析了输入（有向）图的扩张性质与所构造码参数之间的关系，给出了优于Kaufman-Lubotzky结果的分析，并构造了一个无限族的好的有向图码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 凯莱码构造虽能产生对称LDPC好码，但受限于凯莱图形结构的刚性，缺乏设计自由度。作者希望通过推广到更一般的（有向）图结构，保留凯莱码的优良属性（如对称性、好码性质）的同时增加构造的灵活性，并改进已有参数分析。

Method: 提出了"图码"和"有向图码"两种推广构造：以一般（有向）图的顶点作为码字位置、以边上的约束代替凯莱码中群作用诱导的约束；通过代数方法（如群/环上的多项式表示）和组合方法（扩张性质分析）研究码的参数，建立输入（有向）图扩张率与所构码的最小距离、速率等参数之间的定量关系，并对Kaufman-Lubotzky的分析进行改进。

Result: 证明了图码和有向图码保留了凯莱码的优良属性（包括对称性与好码特性），同时提供更大的设计自由度；在扩张性质与码参数之间的分析上取得了优于Kaufman-Lubotzky的结果；作为应用，构造了一个无限族的好的有向图码。

Conclusion: 图码和有向图码是对凯莱码的自然且有效的推广，兼具理论上的代数深度与实际构造的灵活性，并为进一步研究留下了一系列开放问题。

Abstract: In 2012, Kaufman and Lubotzky constructed the first family of symmetric LDPC good codes. Their construction used Cayley codes, as originally defined by Kaufman and Wigderson (2016). In this paper we present two generalisations to the Cayley code construction, which we call graph codes and digraph codes. We investigate both the algebraic, and combinatorial properties of these constructions and show that they possess the same desirable attributes as Cayley codes, but with added freedom. We analyse the relationship between the expansion properties of the ingredient (di)graphs and the parameters of the constructed codes; our analysis offers an improvement to the results of Kaufman and Lubotzky. As an application, we construct an infinite family of good digraph codes, and we propose a series of open problems.

</details>


### [421] [On The Most Discriminative Boolean Functions for Correlated Sources](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28162)
*Jun Chen,Shun Watanabe,Lei Yu*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 本文研究布尔函数对在压缩两个相关源后最大化Kullback-Leibler散度的问题，证明了在无偏函数对及非负相关域中的相同函数对条件下，level-k函数（包括parity函数）同时最大化散度和Fisher信息，部分解决了Amari和Kobayashi的猜想，并在贝叶斯分布式一位假设检验框架下证明了level-k函数的最优性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受Amari和Kobayashi猜想的启发，本文旨在解决相关源分布式压缩中的信息度量最大化问题。当参考分布为独立源时，问题退化为最大化互信息，Pichler等人已证明独裁函数（dictator functions）的最优性；而在最大化Fisher信息的局部版本中，Amari和Kobayashi猜想parity函数最优。本文希望验证和推广这一猜想。

Method: 本文使用Fourier分析方法研究布尔函数。具体而言：(1) 对于无偏布尔函数对，以及在非负相关区域中的相同函数对，证明KL散度和Fisher信息均由level-k函数最大化（level-k函数的Fourier系数仅支持在k阶层次上）；(2) 在贝叶斯分布式一位假设检验框架下，证明level-k函数对所有函数对均为最优；(3) 还讨论了单函数版本的问题，将其视为Courtade和Kumar猜想的散度类比。

Result: 本文证明：对于无偏布尔函数对以及非负相关区域中的相同函数对，KL散度和Fisher信息均由level-k函数最大化。由于level-k函数包含parity函数，这部分解决了Amari和Kobayashi的猜想。此外，在贝叶斯分布式一位假设检验框架下，level-k函数在所有函数对中是最优的。

Conclusion: 本文通过Fourier分析方法部分解决了Amari和Kobayashi关于Fisher信息最大化中parity函数最优性的猜想，将其推广到更广泛的level-k函数类，并在假设检验框架下建立了level-k函数的最优性，同时提出了与Courtade-Kumar猜想对应的散度版本问题。

Abstract: Motivated by a conjecture of Amari and Kobayashi, we study the problem of identifying pairs of Boolean functions that maximize the Kullback-Leibler divergence between two distributions obtained by separately compressing two correlated sources. When the reference distribution corresponds to independent sources, this problem reduces to the problem of maximizing mutual information, for which the optimality of dictator functions has been proved by Pichler, Piantanida, and Matz. For the problem of maximizing Fisher information, which can be viewed as a local version of the problem studied in this paper, Amari and Kobayashi conjectured that parity functions are optimal. For unbiased pairs of Boolean functions, and for identical pairs in the nonnegative correlation regime, we prove that both the divergence and the Fisher information are maximized by level-$k$ functions, namely, functions whose Fourier coefficients are supported only on level $k$. Since level-$k$ functions include parity functions, this gives a partial resolution of the conjecture of Amari and Kobayashi. Furthermore, in the framework of Bayesian distributed one-bit hypothesis testing, we prove that level-$k$ functions are optimal among all pairs of functions. Finally, we also discuss the one function version of the problem studied in this paper, which can be regarded as the divergence analogue of the Courtade and Kumar conjecture.

</details>


### [422] [Generalized Query-Oriented Image Semantic Coding Empowered by Large AI Models and Semantic-Aware Hybrid Beamforming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28276)
*Sin-Yu Huang,Vincent W. S. Wong*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种广义的查询导向图像语义编码（QO-ISC）框架，利用预训练大AI模型提升特征泛化能力，并结合语义感知混合波束成形（SA-HBF）算法在大型MIMO-OFDM系统中优先传输语义重要特征，在未见目标类别上优于传统编解码器及现有语义编码方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语义编码存在三个关键问题：1）未考虑用户意图（intent），用户往往只对特定语义内容感兴趣；2）现有语义模型依赖特定数据集微调，泛化能力受限；3）在大规模MIMO-OFDM系统中如何优先传输语义重要特征尚未被充分探索。

Method: 1）提出QO-ISC框架：发射端根据用户查询提取相关特征，接收端基于这些特征重建图像；2）利用预训练大型AI模型（LAM）增强通用特征表示，提升泛化能力；3）开发语义感知混合波束成形（SA-HBF）算法，用于大规模MIMO-OFDM系统中对语义重要特征进行优先级排序和传输。

Result: 在数据集中未见过的目标类别评估中，所提出的广义QO-ISC框架在性能上优于传统编解码器和两种最先进的语义编码方案。

Conclusion: 通过结合查询导向的特征提取、预训练大模型的泛化能力以及语义感知波束成形，该框架有效解决了现有语义通信中意图缺失、泛化受限和特征优先级排序不足的问题，为语义通信在大规模MIMO-OFDM系统中的应用提供了新思路。

Abstract: Semantic communication is an emerging paradigm that can preserve the meaning of data during transmission. However, human users are often interested in specific semantic content based on their intent, and users' intent is often not considered in current semantic coding design. Moreover, most of the existing semantic models are fine-tuned using specific datasets, which limits their generalization capability. Furthermore, how to prioritize semantically important features in large-scale multiple-input multiple-output orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (MIMO-OFDM) systems remains largely unexplored. To address the aforementioned challenges, in this paper, we propose a generalized query-oriented image semantic coding (QO-ISC) framework. In the proposed framework, the transmitter extracts features which are relevant to the user's query and the receiver reconstructs an image based on those features. We use a pretrained large artificial intelligence (AI) model (LAM) to enhance general feature representations. We develop a semantic-aware hybrid beamforming (SA-HBF) algorithm to prioritize semantically important features for large-scale MIMO-OFDM system. When evaluated on unseen object categories within the dataset, simulation results show that our proposed generalized QO-ISC framework achieves better performance than the traditional codec and two state-of-the-art semantic coding schemes.

</details>


### [423] [The Capacity of a Family of Sticky Channels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28281)
*Mladen Kovačević*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 本文确定了q元粘性插入信道（sticky-insertion channels）家族的容量。对于满足特定系数支配条件的重复律（repetition laws），证明了Shannon容量等于零错误容量，均为log₂λ比特/符号，其中λ是方程λ^d = (q-1)(λ^(d-1)+...+λ+1)的唯一正解。这是首次精确确定非平凡重复信道Shannon容量的情况。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重复信道（repeat channels）广泛存在于通信和存储系统中，但其Shannon容量此前从未被精确确定过。本文旨在填补这一空白，为满足特定条件的q元粘性插入信道确定其精确容量。

Method: 作者考虑q元粘性插入信道家族，其中重复律（repetition laws）支撑在1+dℤ≥₀上（即重复次数形如1+kd）。通过系数支配判据（coefficientwise-domination criterion）和支配常数γ≥λ^(-d)来界定可行重复律的集合。利用λ作为特征方程的唯一正解来刻画容量上界，并通过零错误容量与Shannon容量的等价性证明来得到精确结果。文中还构造了满足条件的显式重复律实例，包括加权Fuss-Catalan数给定的重复律。

Result: 对于满足系数支配条件（支配常数γ≥λ^(-d)）且支撑在1+dℤ≥₀上的q元粘性插入信道，其Shannon容量等于零错误容量，均为log₂λ比特/符号，其中λ是特征方程的唯一正解。文中给出了满足条件的显式重复律，包括由加权Fuss-Catalan数构造的实例。这是首次精确确定非平凡重复信道的Shannon容量。

Conclusion: 本文为q元粘性插入信道提供了精确的容量刻画，证明了在适当的重复律条件下Shannon容量与零错误容量一致，并构造了具体的满足条件的重复律。这一结果首次解决了非平凡重复信道Shannon容量的精确确定问题，为该领域的后续研究奠定了重要基础。

Abstract: We determine the capacity of a family of $q$-ary sticky-insertion channels. Fix $q\geq2$ and $d\geq1$, and let $λ$ be the unique positive solution of $λ^d = (q-1) (λ^{d-1} + \cdots + λ+ 1 )$. We prove that, for every repetition law supported on $1+d\mathbb{Z}_{\geq0}$ and satisfying a coefficientwise-domination criterion with domination constant $γ\geqλ^{-d}$, the Shannon capacity equals the zero-error capacity, both being $\log_2λ$ bits per symbol. We also exhibit explicit repetition laws satisfying these conditions, one of which is given by the weighted Fuss--Catalan numbers. To the best of our knowledge, these are the first known cases of nontrivial repeat channels whose Shannon capacity has been determined exactly.

</details>


### [424] [Low-Pathwidth GRAND: Exact Likelihood-Ordered Enumeration for BPSK Transmission over Correlated Gaussian Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28363)
*Behrooz Razeghi*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 本文提出Low-Pathwidth GRAND (LP-GRAND)算法，解决相关高斯噪声下软输入GRAND的有限块最大似然（ML）保证问题。通过利用协方差精度矩阵的带状结构，将候选噪声模式的能量建模为二次伪布尔函数，并利用路径分解和动态规划以非递减能量顺序枚举噪声模式，从而保证首个码本命中即为ML码字。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准GRAND的ML保证依赖于按非递增条件似然顺序查询噪声模式，但在相关高斯噪声下，匹配度量包含交叉坐标交互项，导致加性可靠性度量和独立块近似可能破坏这一顺序，使首个码本命中无法保证为ML码字。需要一种能正确处理相关噪声中交互项并保持ML保证的方法。

Method: LP-GRAND针对BPSK调制和精度矩阵Q的场景：(1) 将候选相关的高斯负对数似然部分建模为依赖观测的二次伪布尔能量，其交互图边{i,j}当且仅当Q_ij≠0；(2) 若Q的半带宽至多为ν，能量可构建每层至多2^ν状态的网格；(3) 利用宽度为w的路径分解，每层至多2^{w+1}个bag赋值；(4) 在实数算术中，通过后缀动态规划和最佳优先完整路径枚举，以非递减能量顺序枚举噪声模式。完整枚举且不放弃时，首个码本命中即为ML码字（针对任何非空且等概率码字的二进制码本）。

Result: 实验表明：(1) 对两个[20,12]码，LP-GRAND在全部10,000帧中与穷举码字ML完全一致；(2) 在E_b/N_0=2dB下，对六个[64,52]码，其经验BLER低于每种基于块的近似方法。

Conclusion: LP-GRAND在相关高斯噪声下能够有效恢复GRAND的ML保证，通过利用精度矩阵的带状结构实现高效的噪声模式枚举，并在实验中验证了其较块近似方法的性能优势。

Abstract: The finite-block maximum-likelihood (ML) guarantee of soft-input GRAND requires querying noise-effect patterns in nonincreasing conditional-likelihood order. Under correlated Gaussian noise, additive reliability metrics and independent-block approximations need not preserve this order because the matched metric contains cross-coordinate interactions; the first codebook hit need not induce an ML codeword. We develop Low-Pathwidth GRAND (LP-GRAND) for binary phase-shift keying (BPSK) with precision matrix $Q$. The candidate-dependent part of the Gaussian negative log-likelihood is an observation-dependent quadratic pseudo-Boolean energy whose interaction graph has edge $\{i,j\}$ exactly when $Q_{ij}\neq0$. If $Q$ has half-bandwidth at most $ν$, this energy admits a trellis with at most $2^ν$ states per layer; a path decomposition of width $w$ yields at most $2^{w+1}$ bag assignments per layer. In real arithmetic, suffix dynamic programming and best-first complete-path enumeration enumerate patterns in nondecreasing energy. With complete enumeration and no abandonment, the first codebook hit induces an ML codeword for any nonempty binary codebook with equiprobable codewords. LP-GRAND agreed with exhaustive codeword ML in all $10{,}000$ frames for two $[20,12]$ codes. At nominal $E_b/N_0=2$ dB, its empirical BLER was lower than that of each block-based approximation for six $[64,52]$ codes.

</details>


### [425] [Forecasting Land Art Under Climate Scenarios](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28489)
*Alev Cinbarci,Sean Kalaycioglu*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 本文基于Robert Smithson的1970年大地艺术作品Spiral Jetty作为固定遥感目标，构建了一个两阶段预测管线：第一阶段使用IPCC AR6三种气候变化情景（SSP1-2.6、SSP2-4.5、SSP5-8.5）预测区域温度、湖面高程、盐度和累计CO2；第二阶段通过线性回归和随机森林预测14个图像复杂度特征，并用基于Stable Diffusion XL + LoRA + ControlNet的气候条件潜在扩散模型生成图像。研究发现所有情景均将输入推向1984-2025训练分布之外，随机森林模型在2015年后的干旱盐滩状态饱和，阈值化水文解释显示Spiral Jetty在所有情景下均完全暴露。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该研究旨在将大地艺术（Land Art）作品作为气候变化的可视化哨兵，利用Spiral Jetty的视觉复杂性反映水文气候条件，并探索如何从过去42年的遥感记录中预测未来气候情景下作品的视觉状态，弥合气候变化模拟与艺术遗产保护之间的鸿沟。

Method: 采用两阶段预测管线：Stage 1基于IPCC AR6 SSP1-2.6、SSP2-4.5和SSP5-8.5温度变化情景预测2030和2050年的区域温度、北/南臂湖面高程、盐度和累计CO2；Stage 2a使用线性回归与随机森林对14个图像复杂度特征进行投影预测；Stage 2b构建气候条件潜在扩散模型，采用Stable Diffusion XL经LoRA微调，以ControlNet注入气候向量，并引入水文物理掩膜进行集成图像合成。

Result: 所有六种情景-年份组合均使输入超出1984-2025训练分布。随机森林在2015年后干旱盐滩状态区域饱和，阈值化水文解释分类显示Spiral Jetty在所有情景下均完全暴露。扩散模型的验证结果将在训练完成后发布。

Conclusion: 该工作展示了将遥感成像、气候情景建模与生成式AI相结合以预测文化遗产景观未来状态的可行性，同时讨论了生成性推测对文化遗产的伦理影响，并规划将类似方法推广至Sun Tunnels、Double Negative、Lightning Field和Roden Crater等其他大地艺术作品。

Abstract: Robert Smithson's 1970 land artwork Spiral Jetty, located in the north arm of Utah's Great Salt Lake, provides a fixed remote-sensing target whose visual complexity reflects hydroclimatic conditions. A companion study analyzed 1,744 co-registered Landsat 4-9 and Sentinel-2 image chips spanning every year and month from 1984 to 2025. It found robust relationships between coarse-scale permutation entropy, mean intensity, and the third principal component of ResNet50 avg-pool embeddings, and lake elevation, regional temperature, and cumulative CO2. It also showed that image complexity leads lake stage by about three years and that the long-term trend is non-monotonic, with decline after 2015. Building on those findings, this paper develops a two-stage forecasting pipeline. Stage 1 applies IPCC AR6 SSP1-2.6, SSP2-4.5, and SSP5-8.5 temperature changes to forecast regional temperature, north- and south-arm lake elevation, salinity, and cumulative CO2 for 2030 and 2050. Stage 2a projects 14 image-complexity features using linear and Random Forest regressions trained on the 42-year record. All six scenario-year combinations move the inputs outside the 1984-2025 training distribution. The Random Forest model therefore saturates near the post-2015 dry-playa regime, while a threshold-based hydrological interpretation classifies Spiral Jetty as fully exposed in every scenario. Stage 2b specifies a climate-conditioned latent-diffusion framework using Stable Diffusion XL fine-tuned with LoRA on the 1,744 chips, ControlNet conditioning on the climate vector, and a hydrological physics mask for ensemble image synthesis. Code is provided, and validation results will be released after diffusion training. We conclude by discussing ethical implications of generative speculation on cultural heritage and outlining a roadmap for forecasting at Sun Tunnels, Double Negative, Lightning Field, and Roden Crater.

</details>

### [426] [A new approach for the determination of through-thickness and free-edge stresses in composite laminates based on structural elements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27559)
*Xiaopeng Ai,Christos Kassapoglou,Boyang Chen*

Main category: cs.CE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于Kirchhoff-Love假说的多层结构单元捕捉自由边缘效应的方法，通过结构内聚单元结合基于富树脂层推导的精确罚刚度，恢复层间离面应力分量，从而准确预测复合材料层合板的损伤起始。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于Kirchhoff-Love假说的薄壳单元仅包含三个面内应力分量（两个正应力和一个剪应力），缺少传统三维损伤准则所需的离面应力分量，导致复合材料层合板的损伤起始无法被准确预测。

Method: 提出一种在任意复合材料铺层的多层结构单元中捕捉自由边缘效应的公式化方法。该方法采用结构内聚单元对复合材料层合板进行建模，并利用从层合板富树脂层推导出的精确罚刚度，通过准确表征界面力学响应来恢复离面应力分量。

Result: 通过精确表征界面力学响应，成功恢复了离面应力分量，使得基于Kirchhoff-Love假说的模型中能够捕捉到自由边缘效应，从而为损伤起始预测提供必要的应力信息。

Conclusion: 该研究提供了一种在不放弃Kirchhoff-Love假说简化优势的前提下，恢复离面应力分量并准确预测复合材料层合板损伤起始的有效途径。

Abstract: Thin shell elements based on the Kirchhoff-Love hypothesis account for only three stress components: the in-plane normal stresses and the in-plane shear stress. The out-of-plane stress components required by conventional three-dimensional damage criteria are unavailable. As a result, damage initiation in composite laminates cannot be accurately predicted. This paper presents a method for capturing free edge effects in multilayer structural elements with arbitrary composite layups based on the Kirchhoff-Love hypothesis.The proposed formulation employs structural cohesive elements to model composite laminates and uses an accurate penalty stiffness derived from the laminate's resin-rich layers. By accurately characterizing the interfacial mechanical response, out-of-plane stress components can be recovered.

</details>


### [427] [Data-free neural PDE solvers based on Graph Neural Networks and weak forms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27901)
*Mikel M. Iparraguirre,Iciar Alfaro,David Gonzalez,Elias Cueto*

Main category: cs.CE

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于物理信息的无数据神经求解器，采用图神经网络和消息传递架构，利用弱形式和有限元形函数梯度（多项式）而非自动微分来计算残差，能够在未见过的载荷和几何上泛化，残差收敛误差<1%，并可将残差作为误差指示器在测试阶段进行细化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理信息神经网络（PINN）在求解偏微分方程时面临自动微分计算负担重、难以处理复杂几何等已知困难；此外，传统方法通常需要昂贵的高保真合成数据来训练网络。作者希望通过结合几何机器学习（GNN）来解决这些问题，并避免数据生成的成本。

Method: 采用图神经网络（GNN）架构，通过消息传递机制实现。利用偏微分方程的弱形式，用有限元形函数（多项式）的梯度替代自动微分来计算网络自身预测位移对应的方程残差。模型为无数据方法（data-free），不依赖预生成训练数据。在推理阶段，若残差超过用户预设的容差，可将残差作为误差指示器触发细化。

Result: 方法在未见载荷工况和未见几何上具有良好的泛化能力，残差收敛误差低于1%，并能扩展到大规模、任意几何的模型。提供了算例验证其性能。

Conclusion: 该方法首次将无数据物理信息训练与几何机器学习（GNN）技术结合，克服了传统PINN在几何偏差上的困难，同时避免了高保真合成数据的获取、整理和存储成本。残差兼作误差指示器可为推理提供物理学合规性保证。

Abstract: We present a physics-informed, data-free neural solver for partial differential equations, built on a graph neural network architecture that utilises message passing. By relying on the weak form of the problem, we use gradients of finite-element shape functions (which are therefore polynomials) rather than automatic differentiation operators to compute the residuals of the equation from the displacements predicted by the network itself. Our approach generalises to previously unseen load cases and geometries, achieving easily convergence errors in the residuals of less than 1% and being capable of scaling up to models of considerable size and arbitrary geometries.
  To ensure compliance with the laws of physics and provide guarantees regarding the inference, it is possible to use the residual itself as an error indicator for the inference, and thus perform a refinement at the testing stage if the residual tolerance set in advance by the user is not met. Examples are provided to demonstrate the performance of the proposed method. This results in a method that avoids the costly process of obtaining, curating and storing high-fidelity synthetic data for training the neural network. Whilst this is not unique to our method, it is the first time it has been combined with a geometric machine learning technique capable of providing the necessary geometric bias to overcome the well-known difficulties of physics-informed neural networks.

</details>


### [428] [Can Large Language Models Execute Parent Orders?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28410)
*Zane Shen,Xinli Xu,Guangyi Zhang,Jialong Chen,Jinsong Zhou,Cong Chen,Guibao Shen,Dongyu Yan,Luozhou Wang,Zhen Yang*

Main category: cs.CE

TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究了大语言模型（LLM）在父订单执行（parent-order execution）问题中的应用，提出PACE（Plan-Ahead Controlled Execution）分层框架，将执行分解为长周期规划和短周期执行，无需显式市场假设或任务特定训练。在深交所Level-1数据上，PACE超越TWAP、Almgren-Chriss及学习类基线方法，比最强基线高出0.65个基点。行为分析还揭示了LLM执行决策与人类投资者的差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有父订单执行方法存在两类局限：基于预设定市场假设的方法（如TWAP、Almgren-Chriss）在实际中假设可能不成立；需要任务特定训练的学习方法在新环境下适应性有限。作者希望利用LLM的泛化能力克服这些限制，将LLM在金融领域的应用从"交易什么"拓展到"如何执行"。

Method: 提出PACE分层框架：上层进行长周期规划（long-horizon planning）确定整体执行策略，下层进行短周期执行（short-horizon execution）即时调整下单。该框架不需要显式市场假设（模型假设）也不需要任务特定训练，充分发挥LLM的规划和泛化能力。

Result: 在深圳证券交易所Level-1数据上，PACE在性能上超越TWAP、Almgren-Chriss以及基于学习的基线方法，相比最强基线提升0.65个基点。行为分析发现：模型置信度越高预测表现越好（与人类投资者模式相反）；模型倾向于更早交易而非拖延至截止时间。

Conclusion: LLM在父订单执行中可以补充（而非替代）人类交易员。其执行决策模式与人类存在系统性差异，这些差异（更早交易、置信度与表现正相关）表明LLM可以与人类交易者形成互补。

Abstract: Parent-order execution is a core problem in algorithmic trading, where the goal is to split a large order into smaller orders while reducing execution costs. Existing approaches either rely on pre-specified market assumptions that may not hold in practice, or require task-specific training that limits adaptability to new settings. To overcome these limitations, we present the first systematic study of large language models (LLMs) for parent-order execution. This extends the use of LLMs in finance from what to trade to how to execute. We propose PACE (Plan-Ahead Controlled Execution), a hierarchical framework that decomposes parent-order execution into long-horizon planning and short-horizon execution, requiring neither explicit market assumptions nor task-specific training. Experiments on Shenzhen Stock Exchange Level-1 data show that PACE outperforms TWAP, Almgren-Chriss, and learning-based baselines, exceeding the strongest baseline by 0.65 bps. Behavioral analysis reveals that LLMs make execution decisions differently from human investors: higher model confidence predicts better performance rather than worse returns, and the model trades earlier rather than procrastinating toward the deadline. These findings suggest that LLMs can complement human traders in execution decisions.

</details>


### [429] [CoLAS: Multimodal Corroboration of Latent Asset Signals for Financial Trading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28446)
*Yanzheng Jin,Pengyang Shao,Xiaohao Liu,Xi Ai,Fei Shen,Kenji Kawaguchi*

Main category: cs.CE

TL;DR: 提出CoLAS框架，将多模态金融数据中的"模态间佐证"（multimodal corroboration）操作化为可训练的任务条件化表示，通过softmax谱目标和带符号模态贡献构建更稳定的交易信号，在股票和加密货币数据集上相较现有方法在年化收益和夏普比率上均取得一致提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有金融多模态方法仅关注利用不同模态（价格序列、新闻、投资者情绪）的互补性，将所有模态视为同等价值，忽略了一个关键问题：不同模态是否对同一交易信号提供相互支持的证据（即任务条件化、非抵消的支持）。由于单一金融观点噪声大且信息弱，跨异构视图持久存在的支持比仅在单一视图中出现的证据更稳定、更具任务相关性，这种多模态佐证性质值得被利用。

Method: CoLAS将模态表示组织成逐实例（per-instance）矩阵，通过基于softmax的谱目标强化矩阵的支配性共享分量；利用带符号的模态贡献判断该分量是否提供非抵消支持，从而构建佐证信号；另设计鲁棒性感知的一致性目标，在模态被破坏或缺失时保持佐证信号的稳定性。

Result: 在股票和加密货币数据集上的大量实验表明，CoLAS相对于现有方法在年化收益和夏普比率上均取得一致性改进。

Conclusion: 多模态佐证是一种比简单互补性更有效的金融信号提取机制，CoLAS通过可训练的任务条件化谱方法成功地将这一思想落地，验证了跨模态持久支持对交易预测的价值。

Abstract: Financial trading relies on extracting reliable signals from heterogeneous market modalities such as price series, breaking news, and investor sentiment. Existing multimodal methods primarily combine heterogeneous modalities to exploit complementarity, treating each modality as equally valuable while overlooking whether different modalities provide mutually supportive evidence for the same trading signal. However, this task-conditioned and non-canceling support, termed multimodal corroboration, is particularly valuable, especially for financial trading. Because individual financial views are noisy and weakly informative, support that persists across heterogeneous views may provide a more stable task-relevant signal than evidence appearing in only one view. To exploit this property, we propose CoLAS (multimodal Corroboration of Latent Asset Signals), a framework that operationalizes multimodal corroboration as a trainable task-conditioned representation for trading prediction. The modality representations are organized into a per-instance matrix, where a softmax-based spectral objective strengthens its dominant shared component. Signed modality contributions then determine whether this component provides non-canceling support and construct the resulting corroborated signal. A coupled robustness-aware consistency objective further preserves the resulting corroborated signal when a modality is corrupted or missing. Extensive experiments on stock and cryptocurrency datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed CoLAS, yielding consistent improvements in both annualized return and Sharpe ratio over existing methods.

</details>


### [430] [Topology optimization of conduction-radiation problems based on a ray-tracing approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28534)
*Shun Noguchi,Naoyuki Ishida,Jike Han,Kazuhiro Izui,Shinji Nishiwaki*

Main category: cs.CE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于密度的拓扑优化方法，用于求解计及多方向相互辐射的传导-辐射耦合传热问题。该方法将基于区域法（zonal method）并融合光线追踪（ray-tracing）的辐射传热分析与有限元热传导分析相结合，在处理优化过程中出现的中间材料密度时将其实体化为参与介质（participating media），从而在隐式表达的结构边界上实现辐射传热的物理一致性评估。采用伴随方法推导了解析设计灵敏度，并通过有限差分法验证其精度。数值算例展示了辐射散热器和辐射屏蔽罩的优化设计，揭示了传导与辐射之间的平衡对最终设计的影响，并生成了传统方法无法获得的多层隔热结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 太空系统中电子设备需要通过辐射传热散热，因此辐射冷却装置的高效设计至关重要。尽管现有拓扑优化方法已在一定程度上纳入辐射传热，但完全考虑多方向相互辐射仍具挑战性。本研究旨在克服这一局限，提出一种能够全面考虑多方向相互辐射效应的拓扑优化方法。

Method: 1) 将基于区域法（zonal method）的辐射传热分析（结合光线追踪法）与有限元热传导分析相耦合；2) 将优化过程中出现的中间材料密度视为参与介质，实现对隐式结构边界上辐射传热的物理一致性评估；3) 采用伴随方法推导解析设计灵敏度，并通过有限差分法验证其准确性。

Result: 数值算例验证了该方法在辐射散热器和辐射屏蔽罩优化中的有效性。散热器算例阐明了传导与辐射之间的平衡如何决定最终设计形态；辐射屏蔽罩算例则生成了传统方法无法得到的多层隔热结构，证明了方法在处理复杂辐射传热问题时的优越性。

Conclusion: 所提出的密度型拓扑优化方法在传导-辐射耦合传热问题中能够全面考虑多方向相互辐射效应，提供物理一致的灵敏度计算，并能生成优于传统方法的优化设计，为太空热管理系统中的辐射冷却器件设计提供了有力工具。

Abstract: Thermal management is essential in space systems, where electronic devices must dissipate heat via radiative heat transfer. To achieve efficient designs of radiative cooling devices, structural optimization approaches such as topology optimization are required. While existing topology optimization methods have incorporated radiative heat transfer with certain simplifications, fully accounting for multidirectional mutual radiation remains challenging. To address this issue, this study proposes a density-based topology optimization method for conduction-radiation heat transfer problems that accounts for multidirectional mutual radiation. The proposed method integrates a zonal-method-based radiative heat transfer analysis incorporating a ray-tracing method into the finite element heat conduction analysis, capturing radiation effects during the optimization process. By treating the intermediate material densities that arise during the optimization as participating media, the proposed method enables a physically consistent evaluation of radiative heat transfer on implicitly represented structural boundaries. The analytical design sensitivities are derived using the adjoint method, and the accuracy is confirmed by the comparison with the numerical sensitivities obtained by the finite difference method. Numerical examples demonstrate the optimization of radiative heat sinks and radiation shields. The heat sink examples clarify how the balance between conduction and radiation governs the resulting designs, while the radiation shield examples produce multilayer insulation structures that are not obtained by conventional approaches.

</details>


### [431] [Train Often, Deploy Selectively: Forward-Gated Model Replacement in Crypto Markets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28577)
*Aditya Dutta*

Main category: cs.CE

TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为Shadow Before Swap (SBS)的模型部署策略，在正式替换模型前先在服务路径之外"影子"式预热训练候选模型，并与持续维护的在任模型在同一批延迟标签上进行比较，仅在达到固定配对负对数似然优势时才进行提升。在Binance加密永续合约期货的48个UTC周历史回放实验中，SBS相对日历替换、调度匹配自动提升和持续维护分别降低NLL 0.1472%、0.0755%和0.0428%，同时将部署模型变更减少78.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产环境的预测系统会定期重训模型，但一个重训的候选模型并不一定优于持续学习维护的在任模型。现有部署策略（如日历替换或自动提升）未充分考虑候选模型与在任模型的相对表现，可能导致模型退化或频繁无效切换，因此需要一个更稳健的部署策略来管理模型状态转换。

Method: SBS策略包含三个步骤：（1）在服务路径之外"影子"式预热拟合一个挑战者模型（warm-refit）；（2）在同一批下一周的延迟标签上，将挑战者与持续维护的在任模型进行配对评估；（3）仅当挑战者达到固定的配对负对数似然（NLL）优势时才将其提升部署。该策略通过历史回放验证，覆盖两个不重叠的Binance时段、48个UTC周、三个随机种子、八个底层资产和两种永续期货合约类型。

Result: SBS相对于日历替换、调度匹配自动提升和持续维护分别降低NLL 0.1472%、0.0755%和0.0428%；对应四周期块区间分别为0.1139%-0.1754%、0.0521%-0.0980%和0.0301%-0.0554%。SBS仅提升了528个挑战者中的114个，将部署模型变更减少了78.4%，同时改善了服务轨迹。该效果在种子、试验预算、提升边际、更早的20资产面板及拓扑匹配监督目标上方向一致。

Conclusion: SBS是一种实用且有效的生产部署策略，能够在降低NLL、提高概率预测质量的同时大幅限制模型的部署变更次数（减少有后果的模型状态转换），兼顾了预测性能与部署稳定性。

Abstract: Production forecasting systems retrain models regularly, but a retrained candidate does not necessarily outperform a continuously maintained incumbent that has continued to learn. We introduce Shadow Before Swap (SBS), a deployment policy that warm-refits a challenger off the serving path, evaluates it against the maintained incumbent on the same next week of delayed labels, and promotes it only after a fixed paired negative-log-likelihood (NLL) advantage.
  In historical replay over two nonoverlapping Binance episodes spanning 48 UTC weeks, three seeds, eight underlyings, and two perpetual-futures contract types, SBS reduces NLL by 0.1472% relative to calendar replacement, 0.0755% relative to schedule-matched automatic promotion, and 0.0428% relative to continuous maintenance. The corresponding episode-stratified four-week block intervals are 0.1139%-0.1754%, 0.0521%-0.0980%, and 0.0301%-0.0554%, respectively. SBS promotes 114 of 528 challengers, reducing deployed model changes by 78.4% while improving the serving trajectory. The effect remains directionally consistent across seeds, trial budgets, promotion margins, an earlier 20-asset panel, and a topology-matched supervised objective. SBS thus provides a practical deployment policy that improves probabilistic forecasts while limiting consequential model-state transitions.

</details>
